        let ctrl_s = InputChord::key_press(vec![ModifierKey::Control], 0x53);
        let ctrl_shift_s = InputChord::key_press(vec![ModifierKey::Control, ModifierKey::Shift], 0x53);
        assert!(matches!(ShortcutCatalog::validate(&ctrl_s), CollisionSeverity::Warning(_)));
        assert_eq!(ShortcutCatalog::validate(&ctrl_shift_s), CollisionSeverity::Allowed);
    }

    #[test]
    fn win_space_is_hard_blocked() {
        let win_space = InputChord::key_press(vec![ModifierKey::Win], 0x20);
        assert!(matches!(
            ShortcutCatalog::validate(&win_space),
            CollisionSeverity::HardBlocked(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn open_home_allows_single_key() {
        let f9 = InputChord::key_press(vec![], 0x78);
        let h = InputChord::key_press(vec![], 0x48);
        assert_eq!(ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(&f9, true), CollisionSeverity::Allowed);
        assert_eq!(ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(&h, true), CollisionSeverity::Allowed);
        assert!(matches!(ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(&h, false), CollisionSeverity::HardBlocked(_)));
    }

===== FILE: E:\Speak-That-Windows\src\input\chord.rs =====
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fmt;
use std::time::Duration;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum ModifierKey {
    Control,
    Shift,
    Alt,
    Win,
}

impl fmt::Display for ModifierKey {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            ModifierKey::Control => write!(f, "Ctrl"),
            ModifierKey::Shift => write!(f, "Shift"),
            ModifierKey::Alt => write!(f, "Alt"),
            ModifierKey::Win => write!(f, "Win"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum TriggerSource {
    Key(u16),         // Virtual Key Code (e.g. VK_SPACE = 0x20)
    MouseButton(u32), // 1: Left, 2: Right, 3: Middle, 4: XButton1 (Back), 5: XButton2 (Forward)
}

impl fmt::Display for TriggerSource {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            TriggerSource::Key(code) => match *code {
                0x20 => write!(f, "Space"),
                0x0D => write!(f, "Enter"),
                0x1B => write!(f, "Esc"),
                0x09 => write!(f, "Tab"),
                0x08 => write!(f, "Backspace"),
                0x2D => write!(f, "Insert"),
                0x2E => write!(f, "Delete"),
                0x24 => write!(f, "Home"),
                0x23 => write!(f, "End"),
                0x21 => write!(f, "PageUp"),
                0x22 => write!(f, "PageDown"),
                0x25 => write!(f, "Left"),
                0x26 => write!(f, "Up"),
                0x27 => write!(f, "Right"),
                0x28 => write!(f, "Down"),
                0x41..=0x5A => write!(f, "{}", (b'A' + (*code as u8 - 0x41)) as char),
                0x30..=0x39 => write!(f, "{}", (b'0' + (*code as u8 - 0x30)) as char),
                0x70..=0x7B => write!(f, "F{}", *code - 0x6F),
                _ => write!(f, "Key(0x{:02X})", code),
            },
            TriggerSource::MouseButton(btn) => match *btn {
                1 => write!(f, "Mouse Left"),
                2 => write!(f, "Mouse Right"),
                3 => write!(f, "Mouse Middle"),
                4 => write!(f, "Mouse 4 (Back)"),
                5 => write!(f, "Mouse 5 (Forward)"),
                _ => write!(f, "Mouse Button {}", btn),
            },
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum TriggerMode {
    Press,
    Hold(Duration),
    Click,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InputChord {
    pub modifiers: Vec<ModifierKey>,
    pub trigger: TriggerSource,
    pub trigger_mode: TriggerMode,
}

impl InputChord {
    pub fn new(modifiers: Vec<ModifierKey>, trigger: TriggerSource, trigger_mode: TriggerMode) -> Self {
        Self {
            modifiers,
            trigger,
            trigger_mode,
        }
    }

    pub fn key_press(modifiers: Vec<ModifierKey>, vk_code: u16) -> Self {
        Self {
            modifiers,
            trigger: TriggerSource::Key(vk_code),
            trigger_mode: TriggerMode::Press,
        }
    }

    pub fn mouse_hold(btn: u32, duration: Duration) -> Self {
        Self {
            modifiers: Vec::new(),
            trigger: TriggerSource::MouseButton(btn),
            trigger_mode: TriggerMode::Hold(duration),
        }
    }

    pub fn total_keys_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.modifiers.len() + 1
    }

    /// Checks if this chord matches another chord regardless of modifier order
    pub fn matches(&self, other: &InputChord) -> bool {
        if self.trigger != other.trigger {
            return false;
        }
        if self.modifiers.len() != other.modifiers.len() {
            return false;
        }
        for m in &self.modifiers {
            if !other.modifiers.contains(m) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        true
    }

    #[allow(dead_code)]
    pub fn mouse_button_and_hold_ms(&self) -> Option<(u32, u64)> {
        if let TriggerSource::MouseButton(btn) = self.trigger {
            let hold_ms = match self.trigger_mode {
                TriggerMode::Hold(d) => d.as_millis() as u64,
                _ => 0,
            };
            Some((btn, hold_ms))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for InputChord {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for m in &self.modifiers {
            parts.push(m.to_string());
        }
        parts.push(self.trigger.to_string());
        let chord_str = parts.join(" + ");
        match self.trigger_mode {
            TriggerMode::Press => write!(f, "{}", chord_str),
            TriggerMode::Click => write!(f, "{} (Click)", chord_str),
            TriggerMode::Hold(dur) => write!(f, "{} (Hold {}ms)", chord_str, dur.as_millis()),
        }
    }
}

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tracing::{debug, info, trace};
use windows::Win32::Foundation::{HINSTANCE, LPARAM, LRESULT, WPARAM};
use windows::Win32::UI::Input::KeyboardAndMouse::GetAsyncKeyState;
use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
    CallNextHookEx, DispatchMessageW, GetMessageW, SetWindowsHookExW, TranslateMessage,
    UnhookWindowsHookEx, HHOOK, KBDLLHOOKSTRUCT, MSLLHOOKSTRUCT, MSG, WH_KEYBOARD_LL,
    WH_MOUSE_LL, WM_KEYDOWN, WM_KEYUP, WM_MBUTTONDOWN, WM_MBUTTONUP, WM_SYSKEYDOWN,
    WM_SYSKEYUP, WM_XBUTTONDOWN, WM_XBUTTONUP,
};

use super::chord::{InputChord, ModifierKey};

const LLKHF_INJECTED_FLAG: u32 = 0x10;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum HookEvent {
    ChordTriggered(InputChord),
    MouseButtonDown(u32), // 3: Middle, 4: XButton1 (Back), 5: XButton2 (Forward)
    MouseButtonUp(u32, Duration),
}

pub struct InputHookManager {
    event_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<HookEvent>,
}

impl InputHookManager {
    pub fn new(event_tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<HookEvent>) -> Self {
        Self { event_tx }
    }

    /// Atomically updates which mouse buttons (bit N = button N) should be intercepted by WH_MOUSE_LL.
    pub fn update_bound_mouse_mask(mask: u32) {
        BOUND_MOUSE_MASK.store(mask, Ordering::SeqCst);
        info!("Updated bound mouse button hook mask: 0x{:02X}", mask);
    }

    /// Spawns the native Win32 low-level message loop hook on a dedicated thread.
    pub fn start_listening(self: Arc<Self>) -> std::thread::JoinHandle<()> {
        std::thread::spawn(move || unsafe {
            let h_instance = HINSTANCE(std::ptr::null_mut());

            let kbd_hook = SetWindowsHookExW(
                WH_KEYBOARD_LL,
                Some(low_level_keyboard_proc),
                h_instance,
                0,
            );

            let mouse_hook = SetWindowsHookExW(
                WH_MOUSE_LL,
                Some(low_level_mouse_proc),
                h_instance,
                0,
            );

            match (kbd_hook, mouse_hook) {
                (Ok(kh), Ok(mh)) => {
                    info!("Win32 WH_KEYBOARD_LL and WH_MOUSE_LL hooks registered successfully.");
                    GLOBAL_HOOK_TX = Some(self.event_tx.clone());

                    let mut msg = MSG::default();
                    while GetMessageW(&mut msg, None, 0, 0).as_bool() {
                        let _ = TranslateMessage(&msg);
                        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
                    }

                    let _ = UnhookWindowsHookEx(kh);
                    let _ = UnhookWindowsHookEx(mh);
                }
                (Err(e1), _) => {
                    tracing::error!("Failed to register WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook: {e1}");
                }
                (_, Err(e2)) => {
                    tracing::error!("Failed to register WH_MOUSE_LL hook: {e2}");
                }
            }
        })
    }
}

static mut GLOBAL_HOOK_TX: Option<mpsc::UnboundedSender<HookEvent>> = None;
static BOUND_MOUSE_MASK: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
static HELD_KEYS_BITMAP: [AtomicU64; 4] = [
    AtomicU64::new(0),
    AtomicU64::new(0),
    AtomicU64::new(0),
    AtomicU64::new(0),
];
static MOUSE_DOWN_TIME_MS: [AtomicU32; 8] = [
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
    AtomicU32::new(0),
];

fn is_modifier_vk(vk: u16) -> bool {
    matches!(
        vk,
        0x10 | 0xA0 | 0xA1 // VK_SHIFT, VK_LSHIFT, VK_RSHIFT
        | 0x11 | 0xA2 | 0xA3 // VK_CONTROL, VK_LCONTROL, VK_RCONTROL
        | 0x12 | 0xA4 | 0xA5 // VK_MENU, VK_LMENU, VK_RMENU
        | 0x5B | 0x5C // VK_LWIN, VK_RWIN
    )
}

/// Marks `vk` as held; returns `true` if it was ALREADY held (OS key repeat).
fn mark_key_down_and_was_held(vk: u16) -> bool {
    let idx = (vk as usize) / 64;
    if idx >= HELD_KEYS_BITMAP.len() {
        return false;
    }
    let bit = 1u64 << ((vk as usize) % 64);
    let prev = HELD_KEYS_BITMAP[idx].fetch_or(bit, Ordering::SeqCst);
    (prev & bit) != 0
}

fn mark_key_up(vk: u16) {
    let idx = (vk as usize) / 64;
    if idx < HELD_KEYS_BITMAP.len() {
        let bit = 1u64 << ((vk as usize) % 64);
        HELD_KEYS_BITMAP[idx].fetch_and(!bit, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
}

unsafe extern "system" fn low_level_keyboard_proc(
    n_code: i32,
    w_param: WPARAM,
    l_param: LPARAM,
) -> LRESULT {
    if n_code >= 0 {
        let msg = w_param.0 as u32;
        let kbd = *(l_param.0 as *const KBDLLHOOKSTRUCT);

        // Ignore synthetic/injected keystrokes (so our own Ctrl+C or TextInjector never feeds back)
        if (kbd.flags.0 & LLKHF_INJECTED_FLAG) != 0 {
            return CallNextHookEx(HHOOK(std::ptr::null_mut()), n_code, w_param, l_param);
        }

        let vk = kbd.vkCode as u16;

        if msg == WM_KEYUP || msg == WM_SYSKEYUP {
            mark_key_up(vk);
        } else if msg == WM_KEYDOWN || msg == WM_SYSKEYDOWN {
            // Only evaluate chord when a non-modifier key is freshly pressed (skip OS auto-repeat)
            if !is_modifier_vk(vk) && !mark_key_down_and_was_held(vk) {
                let ctrl_down = (GetAsyncKeyState(0x11) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA2) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA3) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0;

                let shift_down = (GetAsyncKeyState(0x10) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA0) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA1) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0;

                let alt_down = (GetAsyncKeyState(0x12) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA4) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0xA5) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || msg == WM_SYSKEYDOWN;

                let win_down = (GetAsyncKeyState(0x5B) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0
                    || (GetAsyncKeyState(0x5C) as u16 & 0x8000) != 0;

                let mut modifiers = Vec::new();
                if ctrl_down {
                    modifiers.push(ModifierKey::Control);
                }
                if shift_down {
                    modifiers.push(ModifierKey::Shift);
                }
                if alt_down {
                    modifiers.push(ModifierKey::Alt);
                }
                if win_down {
                    modifiers.push(ModifierKey::Win);
                }

                let chord = InputChord::key_press(modifiers, vk);
                trace!("Hook captured key chord: {}", chord);

                if let Some(ref tx) = GLOBAL_HOOK_TX {
                    let _ = tx.send(HookEvent::ChordTriggered(chord));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    CallNextHookEx(HHOOK(std::ptr::null_mut()), n_code, w_param, l_param)
}

unsafe extern "system" fn low_level_mouse_proc(
    n_code: i32,
    w_param: WPARAM,
    l_param: LPARAM,
) -> LRESULT {
    if n_code >= 0 {
        let msg = w_param.0 as u32;
        let ms = *(l_param.0 as *const MSLLHOOKSTRUCT);

        let (is_down, btn_id): (bool, u32) = match msg {
            WM_XBUTTONDOWN => {
                let xb = (ms.mouseData >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                (true, if xb == 1 { 4 } else if xb == 2 { 5 } else { 0 })
            }
            WM_XBUTTONUP => {
                let xb = (ms.mouseData >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                (false, if xb == 1 { 4 } else if xb == 2 { 5 } else { 0 })
            }
            WM_MBUTTONDOWN => (true, 3),
            WM_MBUTTONUP => (false, 3),
            _ => (false, 0),
        };

        if btn_id >= 3 && (btn_id as usize) < MOUSE_DOWN_TIME_MS.len() {
            let bound = (BOUND_MOUSE_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & (1u32 << btn_id)) != 0;
            if bound {
                if is_down {
                    MOUSE_DOWN_TIME_MS[btn_id as usize].store(ms.time, Ordering::SeqCst);
                    debug!("Hook captured bound mouse button {} DOWN", btn_id);
                    if let Some(ref tx) = GLOBAL_HOOK_TX {
                        let _ = tx.send(HookEvent::MouseButtonDown(btn_id));
                    }
                } else {
                    let start_ms = MOUSE_DOWN_TIME_MS[btn_id as usize].swap(0, Ordering::SeqCst);
                    let duration_ms = if start_ms > 0 {
                        ms.time.saturating_sub(start_ms)
                    } else {
                        0
                    };
                    debug!(
                        "Hook captured bound mouse button {} UP ({}ms)",
                        btn_id, duration_ms
                    );
                    if let Some(ref tx) = GLOBAL_HOOK_TX {
                        let _ = tx.send(HookEvent::MouseButtonUp(
                            btn_id,
                            Duration::from_millis(duration_ms as u64),
                        ));
                    }
                }
                // Intercept both DOWN and UP for bound mouse buttons so target apps do not navigate Back or lose selection
                return LRESULT(1);
            }
        }
    }
    CallNextHookEx(HHOOK(std::ptr::null_mut()), n_code, w_param, l_param)
}

use windows::Win32::UI::Input::KeyboardAndMouse::{
    SendInput, INPUT, INPUT_0, INPUT_KEYBOARD, KEYBDINPUT, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, KEYEVENTF_UNICODE,
};

pub struct TextInjector;

impl TextInjector {
    /// Injects text directly into the active Windows window using `SendInput`
    /// with `KEYEVENTF_UNICODE`.
    ///
    /// Correctly splits astral plane Unicode characters (emojis, complex symbols)
    /// into high and low UTF-16 surrogate pairs, each paired with down and up events.
    pub fn inject_text(text: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut inputs = Vec::new();

        for ch in text.chars() {
            let mut utf16_buf = [0u16; 2];
            let encoded = ch.encode_utf16(&mut utf16_buf);

            for &unit in encoded.iter() {
                // Key Down Event
                inputs.push(INPUT {
                    r#type: INPUT_KEYBOARD,
                    Anonymous: INPUT_0 {
                        ki: KEYBDINPUT {
                            wVk: Default::default(),
                            wScan: unit,
                            dwFlags: KEYEVENTF_UNICODE,
                            time: 0,
                            dwExtraInfo: 0,
                        },
                    },
                });

                // Key Up Event
                inputs.push(INPUT {
                    r#type: INPUT_KEYBOARD,
                    Anonymous: INPUT_0 {
                        ki: KEYBDINPUT {
                            wVk: Default::default(),
                            wScan: unit,
                            dwFlags: KEYEVENTF_UNICODE | KEYEVENTF_KEYUP,
                            time: 0,
                            dwExtraInfo: 0,
                        },
                    },
                });
            }
        }

        if inputs.is_empty() {
            return Ok(());
        }

        let sent = unsafe {
            SendInput(
                &inputs,
                std::mem::size_of::<INPUT>() as i32,
            )
        };

        if sent != inputs.len() as u32 {
            return Err(format!(
                "Failed to inject full text: sent {} of {} input events",
                sent,
                inputs.len()
            ));
        }

        Ok(())
    }
}

use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BrowserKind {
    Chrome,
    Edge,
    Brave,
    Firefox,
    Opera,
    OperaGX,
    Vivaldi,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct InstalledBrowser {
    pub kind: BrowserKind,
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub executable_path: PathBuf,
    pub extension_folder: PathBuf,
    pub install_url: &'static str,
}

pub struct BrowserDetector;

impl BrowserDetector {
    pub fn find_project_root() -> PathBuf {
        // 1. Check starting from executable location (supports both release layout & dev tree)
        if let Ok(exe_path) = std::env::current_exe() {
            let mut curr = exe_path.parent();
            while let Some(dir) = curr {
                if dir.join("ADHD_Bionic-Reader").is_dir() || dir.join("extensions").is_dir() {
                    return dir.to_path_buf();
                }
                curr = dir.parent();
            }
        }
        // 2. Check starting from current working directory
        if let Ok(cwd) = std::env::current_dir() {
            let mut curr = Some(cwd.as_path());
            while let Some(dir) = curr {
                if dir.join("ADHD_Bionic-Reader").is_dir() || dir.join("extensions").is_dir() {
                    return dir.to_path_buf();
                }
                curr = dir.parent();
            }
        }
        // 3. Fallback
        PathBuf::from(".")
    }

    pub fn get_extension_path_chromium() -> PathBuf {
        if let Ok(exe_path) = std::env::current_exe() {
            if let Some(exe_dir) = exe_path.parent() {
                let packaged = exe_dir.join("extensions").join("chromium");
                if packaged.is_dir() {
                    return packaged;
                }
            }
        }
        let root = Self::find_project_root();
        let packaged_root = root.join("extensions").join("chromium");
        if packaged_root.is_dir() {
            return packaged_root;
        }
        root.join("ADHD_Bionic-Reader")
            .join("ADHD_Bionic-Reader Extantion Unpacked Loader")
    }

    pub fn get_extension_path_firefox() -> PathBuf {
        if let Ok(exe_path) = std::env::current_exe() {
            if let Some(exe_dir) = exe_path.parent() {
                let packaged = exe_dir.join("extensions").join("firefox");
                if packaged.is_dir() {
                    return packaged;
                }
            }
        }
        let root = Self::find_project_root();
        let packaged_root = root.join("extensions").join("firefox");
        if packaged_root.is_dir() {
            return packaged_root;
        }
        root.join("ADHD_Bionic-Reader").join("extension_firefox")
    }

    pub fn detect_all() -> Vec<InstalledBrowser> {
        let mut found = Vec::new();

        let local_app_data = dirs::data_local_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("C:\\Users\\Default\\AppData\\Local"));
        let program_files = PathBuf::from("C:\\Program Files");
        let program_files_x86 = PathBuf::from("C:\\Program Files (x86)");

        let candidates = vec![
            (
                BrowserKind::Chrome,
                "Google Chrome",
                vec![
                    program_files.join("Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"),
                    local_app_data.join("Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "chrome://extensions",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::Edge,
                "Microsoft Edge",
                vec![
                    program_files_x86.join("Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe"),
                    program_files.join("Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "edge://extensions",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::Brave,
                "Brave Browser",
                vec![
                    program_files.join("BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\Application\\brave.exe"),
                    local_app_data.join("BraveSoftware\\Brave-Browser\\Application\\brave.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "brave://extensions",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::Firefox,
                "Mozilla Firefox",
                vec![
                    program_files.join("Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe"),
                    program_files_x86.join("Mozilla Firefox\\firefox.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_firefox(),
                "about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::OperaGX,
                "Opera GX",
                vec![
                    local_app_data.join("Programs\\Opera GX\\launcher.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "opera://extensions",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::Opera,
                "Opera",
                vec![
                    local_app_data.join("Programs\\Opera\\launcher.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "opera://extensions",
            ),
            (
                BrowserKind::Vivaldi,
                "Vivaldi",
                vec![
                    local_app_data.join("Vivaldi\\Application\\vivaldi.exe"),
                    program_files.join("Vivaldi\\Application\\vivaldi.exe"),
                ],
                Self::get_extension_path_chromium(),
                "vivaldi://extensions",
            ),
        ];

        for (kind, name, paths, ext_path, url) in candidates {
            for exe in paths {
                if exe.exists() {
                    found.push(InstalledBrowser {
                        kind,
                        name,
                        executable_path: exe,
                        extension_folder: ext_path,
                        install_url: url,
                    });
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        found
    }
}

/// Loads Windows Segoe UI / Symbol / Emoji fonts into egui as fallbacks so no missing-glyph boxes appear.
pub fn configure_windows_fonts(ctx: &egui::Context) {
    let mut fonts = egui::FontDefinitions::default();
    let candidates = [
        ("segoe_ui", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\segoeui.ttf"),
        ("segoe_symbol", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\seguisym.ttf"),
        ("segoe_emoji", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\seguiemj.ttf"),
    ];

    for (name, path) in candidates {
        if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(path) {
            fonts
                .font_data
                .insert(name.to_owned(), egui::FontData::from_owned(bytes));
            if let Some(fam) = fonts.families.get_mut(&egui::FontFamily::Proportional) {
                fam.push(name.to_owned());
            }
            if let Some(fam) = fonts.families.get_mut(&egui::FontFamily::Monospace) {
                fam.push(name.to_owned());
            }
        }
    }

    ctx.set_fonts(fonts);
}

const COMMON_KEYS: [(&str, u16); 48] = [
    ("Space", 0x20),
    ("Enter", 0x0D),
    ("Tab", 0x09),
    ("Esc", 0x1B),
    ("Home", 0x24),
    ("End", 0x23),
    ("Insert", 0x2D),
    ("Delete", 0x2E),
    ("A", 0x41), ("B", 0x42), ("C", 0x43), ("D", 0x44), ("E", 0x45),
    ("F", 0x46), ("G", 0x47), ("H", 0x48), ("I", 0x49), ("J", 0x4A),
    ("K", 0x4B), ("L", 0x4C), ("M", 0x4D), ("N", 0x4E), ("O", 0x4F),
    ("P", 0x50), ("Q", 0x51), ("R", 0x52), ("S", 0x53), ("T", 0x54),
    ("U", 0x55), ("V", 0x56), ("W", 0x57), ("X", 0x58), ("Y", 0x59),
    ("Z", 0x5A),
    ("0", 0x30), ("1", 0x31), ("2", 0x32), ("3", 0x33), ("4", 0x34),
    ("5", 0x35), ("6", 0x36), ("7", 0x37), ("8", 0x38), ("9", 0x39),
    ("F8", 0x77), ("F9", 0x78), ("F10", 0x79), ("F12", 0x7B),
];

fn vk_display_name(vk: u16) -> String {
    if let Some(&(name, _)) = COMMON_KEYS.iter().find(|(_, code)| *code == vk) {
        return name.to_string();
    }
    if (0x70..=0x7B).contains(&vk) {
        return format!("F{}", vk - 0x6F);
    }
    format!("Key(0x{:02X})", vk)
}

fn egui_key_to_vk(key: egui::Key) -> Option<u16> {
    use egui::Key;
    Some(match key {
        Key::Space => 0x20,
        Key::Enter => 0x0D,
        Key::Tab => 0x09,
        Key::Escape => 0x1B,
        Key::Backspace => 0x08,
        Key::Insert => 0x2D,
        Key::Delete => 0x2E,
        Key::Home => 0x24,
        Key::End => 0x23,
        Key::PageUp => 0x21,
        Key::PageDown => 0x22,
        Key::ArrowLeft => 0x25,
        Key::ArrowUp => 0x26,
        Key::ArrowRight => 0x27,
        Key::ArrowDown => 0x28,
        Key::A => 0x41, Key::B => 0x42, Key::C => 0x43, Key::D => 0x44, Key::E => 0x45,
        Key::F => 0x46, Key::G => 0x47, Key::H => 0x48, Key::I => 0x49, Key::J => 0x4A,
        Key::K => 0x4B, Key::L => 0x4C, Key::M => 0x4D, Key::N => 0x4E, Key::O => 0x4F,
        Key::P => 0x50, Key::Q => 0x51, Key::R => 0x52, Key::S => 0x53, Key::T => 0x54,
        Key::U => 0x55, Key::V => 0x56, Key::W => 0x57, Key::X => 0x58, Key::Y => 0x59,
        Key::Z => 0x5A,
        Key::Num0 => 0x30, Key::Num1 => 0x31, Key::Num2 => 0x32, Key::Num3 => 0x33, Key::Num4 => 0x34,
        Key::Num5 => 0x35, Key::Num6 => 0x36, Key::Num7 => 0x37, Key::Num8 => 0x38, Key::Num9 => 0x39,
        Key::F1 => 0x70, Key::F2 => 0x71, Key::F3 => 0x72, Key::F4 => 0x73,
        Key::F5 => 0x74, Key::F6 => 0x75, Key::F7 => 0x76, Key::F8 => 0x77,
        Key::F9 => 0x78, Key::F10 => 0x79, Key::F11 => 0x7A, Key::F12 => 0x7B,
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn mouse_btn_label(btn: Option<u32>) -> &'static str {
    match btn {
        None => "None",
        Some(4) => "Mouse 4 (Back)",
        Some(5) => "Mouse 5 (Forward)",
        Some(3) => "Mouse Middle",
        Some(_) => "Other Button",
    }
}

impl SettingsDashboard {
    pub fn new(
        cc: &eframe::CreationContext<'_>,
        config: AppConfig,
        shared_shortcuts: Arc<RwLock<ShortcutConfig>>,
        tts: Arc<TtsEngine>,
    ) -> Self {
        configure_windows_fonts(&cc.egui_ctx);
        let browsers = BrowserDetector::detect_all();
        Self {
            config,
            shared_shortcuts,
            active_tab: DashboardTab::Shortcuts,
            tts,
            browsers,
            test_text: "Hello! This is offline neural speech powered by Paradee 8M.".to_string(),
            stt_rx: None,
            status_message: None,
            editing_keyboard: None,
            capturing_live_key: false,
            draft_ctrl: true,
            draft_shift: false,
            draft_alt: false,
            draft_win: false,
            draft_key_vk: 0x20,
        }
    }

    fn init_keyboard_draft(&mut self, chord: &InputChord) {
        self.draft_ctrl = chord.modifiers.contains(&ModifierKey::Control);
        self.draft_shift = chord.modifiers.contains(&ModifierKey::Shift);
        self.draft_alt = chord.modifiers.contains(&ModifierKey::Alt);
        self.draft_win = chord.modifiers.contains(&ModifierKey::Win);
        self.draft_key_vk = match chord.trigger {
            TriggerSource::Key(vk) => vk,
            _ => 0x20,
        };
        self.capturing_live_key = true;
    }

    fn build_keyboard_draft(&self) -> InputChord {
        let mut mods = Vec::new();
        if self.draft_ctrl {
            mods.push(ModifierKey::Control);
        }
        if self.draft_shift {
            mods.push(ModifierKey::Shift);
        }
        if self.draft_alt {
            mods.push(ModifierKey::Alt);
        }
        if self.draft_win {
            mods.push(ModifierKey::Win);
        }
        InputChord::key_press(mods, self.draft_key_vk)
    }

    fn binding_mut(&mut self, target: EditingShortcut) -> &mut ActionBinding {
        match target {
            EditingShortcut::SpeakSelection => &mut self.config.shortcuts.speak_selection,
            EditingShortcut::StopSpeaking => &mut self.config.shortcuts.stop_speaking,
            EditingShortcut::PushToTalk => &mut self.config.shortcuts.push_to_talk,
            EditingShortcut::OpenHome => &mut self.config.shortcuts.open_home,
            EditingShortcut::ToggleBionic => &mut self.config.shortcuts.toggle_bionic,
            EditingShortcut::ToggleReader => &mut self.config.shortcuts.toggle_reader,
        }
    }

    fn apply_and_save_shortcuts(&mut self, msg: &str) {
        if let Ok(mut guard) = self.shared_shortcuts.write() {
            *guard = self.config.shortcuts.clone();
        }
        InputHookManager::update_bound_mouse_mask(self.config.shortcuts.bound_mouse_mask());
        let _ = self.config.save();
        self.status_message = Some(msg.to_string());
    }

    fn count_duplicate_bindings(&self, target: EditingShortcut) -> Option<String> {
        let rows = [
            (EditingShortcut::SpeakSelection, &self.config.shortcuts.speak_selection),
            (EditingShortcut::StopSpeaking, &self.config.shortcuts.stop_speaking),
            (EditingShortcut::PushToTalk, &self.config.shortcuts.push_to_talk),
            (EditingShortcut::OpenHome, &self.config.shortcuts.open_home),
            (EditingShortcut::ToggleBionic, &self.config.shortcuts.toggle_bionic),
            (EditingShortcut::ToggleReader, &self.config.shortcuts.toggle_reader),
        ];
        let current = match target {
            EditingShortcut::SpeakSelection => &self.config.shortcuts.speak_selection,
            EditingShortcut::StopSpeaking => &self.config.shortcuts.stop_speaking,
            EditingShortcut::PushToTalk => &self.config.shortcuts.push_to_talk,
            EditingShortcut::OpenHome => &self.config.shortcuts.open_home,
            EditingShortcut::ToggleBionic => &self.config.shortcuts.toggle_bionic,
            EditingShortcut::ToggleReader => &self.config.shortcuts.toggle_reader,
        };

        for (other_id, other) in rows {
            if other_id == target {
                continue;
            }
            if current.keyboard.matches(&other.keyboard) {
                return Some(format!("Keyboard duplicates '{}'.", other_id.title()));
            }
            if let (Some(m1), Some(m2)) = (current.mouse_button(), other.mouse_button()) {
                if m1 == m2 {
                    return Some(format!("Mouse button duplicates '{}'.", other_id.title()));
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }

    fn render_keyboard_modal(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context) {
        let Some(target) = self.editing_keyboard else {
            return;
        };

        let mut close_modal = false;
        let mut save_binding = false;

        egui::Window::new(format!("Change Keyboard Shortcut — {}", target.title()))
            .collapsible(false)
            .resizable(false)
            .anchor(egui::Align2::CENTER_CENTER, [0.0, 0.0])
            .fixed_size([430.0, 290.0])
            .show(ctx, |ui| {
                let note = if target.allows_single_key() {
                    "Supports any 1-key shortcut (e.g. F9) or 2-4 key combo (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+S)."
                } else {
                    "Supports any 2-4 key combo (e.g. Ctrl+Space, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+P) or F1-F12."
                };
                ui.add(egui::Label::new(note).wrap(true));
                ui.add_space(8.0);

                // Live Key Capture Box
                if self.capturing_live_key {
                    ctx.input(|i| {
                        for ev in &i.events {
                            if let egui::Event::Key {
                                key,
                                pressed: true,
                                modifiers,
                                ..
                            } = ev
                            {
                                // Bare Escape cancels capture mode rather than overwriting
                                if *key == egui::Key::Escape
                                    && !modifiers.ctrl
                                    && !modifiers.shift
                                    && !modifiers.alt
                                {
                                    self.capturing_live_key = false;
                                    break;
                                }
                                if let Some(vk) = egui_key_to_vk(*key) {
                                    self.draft_ctrl = modifiers.ctrl || modifiers.command;
                                    self.draft_shift = modifiers.shift;
                                    self.draft_alt = modifiers.alt;
                                    self.draft_win = false;
                                    self.draft_key_vk = vk;
                                    self.capturing_live_key = false;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                ui.group(|ui| {
                    ui.set_width(400.0);
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        if self.capturing_live_key {
                            ui.colored_label(
                                egui::Color32::from_rgb(80, 180, 255),
                                "Listening... Press any key combination now!",
                            );
                            if ui.button("Stop").clicked() {
                                self.capturing_live_key = false;
                            }
                        } else {
                            ui.label("Live Key Capture:");
                            if ui.button("Record Key Combo").clicked() {
                                self.capturing_live_key = true;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });

                ui.add_space(8.0);

                // Manual Modifier & Key Builder
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label("Modifiers:");
                    ui.checkbox(&mut self.draft_ctrl, "Ctrl");
                    ui.checkbox(&mut self.draft_shift, "Shift");
                    ui.checkbox(&mut self.draft_alt, "Alt");
                    ui.checkbox(&mut self.draft_win, "Win");
                });

                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label("Trigger Key:");
                    egui::ComboBox::from_id_source("modal_key_combo")
                        .selected_text(vk_display_name(self.draft_key_vk))
                        .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                            for &(name, vk) in &COMMON_KEYS {
                                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.draft_key_vk, vk, name);
                            }
                        });
                });

                let draft_chord = self.build_keyboard_draft();
                ui.add_space(8.0);
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    ui.label("Selected Chord:");
                    ui.label(egui::RichText::new(draft_chord.to_string()).strong());
                });

                let validation =
                    ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(&draft_chord, target.allows_single_key());
                let can_save = match &validation {
                    CollisionSeverity::Allowed => {
                        ui.colored_label(
                            egui::Color32::from_rgb(46, 204, 113),
                            "✓ Safe to bind",
                        );
                        true
                    }
                    CollisionSeverity::Warning(w) => {
                        ui.add(
                            egui::Label::new(
                                egui::RichText::new(format!("Warning: {w}"))
                                    .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(241, 196, 15)),
                            )
                            .wrap(true),
                        );
                        true
                    }
                    CollisionSeverity::HardBlocked(b) => {
                        ui.add(
                            egui::Label::new(
                                egui::RichText::new(format!("Blocked: {b}"))
                                    .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(231, 76, 60)),
                            )
                            .wrap(true),
                        );
                        false
                    }
                };

                ui.add_space(10.0);
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    if ui
                        .add_enabled(can_save, egui::Button::new("Save & Bind"))
                        .clicked()
                    {
                        save_binding = true;
                        close_modal = true;
                    }
                    if ui.button("Cancel").clicked() {
                        close_modal = true;
                    }
                });
            });

        if save_binding {
            let new_chord = self.build_keyboard_draft();
            self.binding_mut(target).keyboard = new_chord;
            self.apply_and_save_shortcuts(&format!(
                "Updated keyboard shortcut for {} (active immediately).",
                target.title()
            ));
        }
        if close_modal {
            self.editing_keyboard = None;
            self.capturing_live_key = false;
        }
    }
}

impl eframe::App for SettingsDashboard {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, _frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        egui::CentralPanel::default().show(ctx, |ui| {
            ui.heading("SpeakThat + ADHD Bionic Reader Settings");
            ui.label("Unified Windows Accessibility Suite (v0.2.0)");
            ui.separator();

            // Tab Bar (clean, zero unsupported tofu glyphs)
            ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.active_tab, DashboardTab::Shortcuts, "Shortcuts");
                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.active_tab, DashboardTab::Voice, "Voice (Paradee)");
                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.active_tab, DashboardTab::Bionic, "Bionic Reader");
                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.active_tab, DashboardTab::Dictation, "Dictation (STT)");
                ui.selectable_value(&mut self.active_tab, DashboardTab::Browsers, "Browsers");
            });
            ui.separator();

            egui::ScrollArea::vertical().show(ui, |ui| match self.active_tab {
                DashboardTab::Shortcuts => {
                    ui.subheading("Global Shortcuts (Keyboard + Mouse)");
                    ui.label(
                        "Every action supports BOTH an active keyboard shortcut (2-4 keys, or 1 key for Open Home)\nand an optional multi-button mouse binding simultaneously.",
                    );
                    ui.add_space(10.0);

                    let mut open_kb_modal: Option<(EditingShortcut, InputChord)> = None;
                    let mut mouse_changed = false;

                    let col_w_action = 138.0;
                    let col_w_kb = 188.0;
                    let col_w_mouse = 228.0;
                    let col_w_status = 185.0;

                    egui::Grid::new("shortcuts_grid")
                        .num_columns(4)
                        .striped(true)
                        .spacing([10.0, 12.0])
                        .show(ui, |ui| {
                            // Header Row
                            ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_action, 20.0), |ui| {
                                ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Action").strong());
                            });
                            ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_kb, 20.0), |ui| {
                                ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Keyboard Shortcut").strong());
                            });
                            ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_mouse, 20.0), |ui| {
                                ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Mouse Button (Optional)").strong());
                            });
                            ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_status, 20.0), |ui| {
                                ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Status").strong());
                            });
                            ui.end_row();

                            let targets = [
                                EditingShortcut::SpeakSelection,
                                EditingShortcut::StopSpeaking,
                                EditingShortcut::PushToTalk,
                                EditingShortcut::OpenHome,
                                EditingShortcut::ToggleBionic,
                                EditingShortcut::ToggleReader,
                            ];

                            for (idx, target) in targets.into_iter().enumerate() {
                                let dup_warning = self.count_duplicate_bindings(target);
                                let binding_snapshot = self.binding_mut(target).clone();

                                // Col 1: Action Name
                                ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_action, 28.0), |ui| {
                                    ui.add(
                                        egui::Label::new(egui::RichText::new(target.title()).strong())
                                            .wrap(true),
                                    );
                                });

                                // Col 2: Keyboard Binding + Change Button
                                ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_kb, 28.0), |ui| {
                                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                                        ui.label(binding_snapshot.keyboard.to_string());
                                        if ui.button("Change").clicked() {
                                            open_kb_modal =
                                                Some((target, binding_snapshot.keyboard.clone()));
                                        }
                                    });
                                });

                                // Col 3: Mouse Binding Dropdown + Hold Duration
                                ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_mouse, 28.0), |ui| {
                                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                                        let mut selected_btn = binding_snapshot.mouse_button();
                                        let mut hold_ms = binding_snapshot.mouse_hold_ms();

                                        egui::ComboBox::from_id_source(format!("mouse_combo_{idx}"))
                                            .width(128.0)
                                            .selected_text(mouse_btn_label(selected_btn))
                                            .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                                                ui.selectable_value(&mut selected_btn, None, "None");
                                                ui.selectable_value(
                                                    &mut selected_btn,
                                                    Some(4),
                                                    "Mouse 4 (Back)",
                                                );
                                                ui.selectable_value(
                                                    &mut selected_btn,
                                                    Some(5),
                                                    "Mouse 5 (Forward)",
                                                );
                                                ui.selectable_value(
                                                    &mut selected_btn,
                                                    Some(3),
                                                    "Mouse Middle",
                                                );
                                            });

                                        if selected_btn != binding_snapshot.mouse_button() {
                                            let default_hold = if target == EditingShortcut::PushToTalk {
                                                200
                                            } else {
                                                0
                                            };
                                            self.binding_mut(target).mouse = selected_btn.map(|btn| {
                                                InputChord::mouse_hold(
                                                    btn,
                                                    Duration::from_millis(default_hold),
                                                )
                                            });
                                            mouse_changed = true;
                                        } else if let Some(btn) = selected_btn {
                                            ui.label("Hold:");
                                            let resp = ui.add(
                                                egui::DragValue::new(&mut hold_ms)
                                                    .clamp_range(0..=500)
                                                    .speed(5)
                                                    .suffix(" ms"),
                                            );
                                            if resp.changed() {
                                                self.binding_mut(target).mouse = Some(
                                                    InputChord::mouse_hold(
                                                        btn,
                                                        Duration::from_millis(hold_ms),
                                                    ),
                                                );
                                                mouse_changed = true;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    });
                                });

                                // Col 4: Status with proper text wrapping
                                ui.allocate_ui(egui::vec2(col_w_status, 28.0), |ui| {
                                    ui.set_width(col_w_status);
                                    let validation = ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(
                                        &binding_snapshot.keyboard,
                                        target.allows_single_key(),
                                    );
                                    match (validation, dup_warning) {
                                        (CollisionSeverity::HardBlocked(b), _) => {
                                            ui.add(
                                                egui::Label::new(
                                                    egui::RichText::new(format!("Blocked: {b}"))
                                                        .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(231, 76, 60)),
                                                )
                                                .wrap(true),
                                            );
                                        }
                                        (CollisionSeverity::Warning(w), _) => {
                                            ui.add(
                                                egui::Label::new(
                                                    egui::RichText::new(format!("Warning: {w}"))
                                                        .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(241, 196, 15)),
                                                )
                                                .wrap(true),
                                            );
                                        }
                                        (CollisionSeverity::Allowed, Some(dup)) => {
                                            ui.add(
                                                egui::Label::new(
                                                    egui::RichText::new(format!("Warning: {dup}"))
                                                        .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(241, 196, 15)),
                                                )
                                                .wrap(true),
                                            );
                                        }
                                        (CollisionSeverity::Allowed, None) => {
                                            ui.add(
                                                egui::Label::new(
                                                    egui::RichText::new("✓ Safe")
                                                        .color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(46, 204, 113)),
                                                )
                                                .wrap(true),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                });

                                ui.end_row();
                            }
                        });

                    if let Some((target, kb_chord)) = open_kb_modal {
                        self.init_keyboard_draft(&kb_chord);
                        self.editing_keyboard = Some(target);
                    }
                    if mouse_changed {
                        self.apply_and_save_shortcuts(
                            "Mouse binding updated and saved (active immediately).",
                        );
                    }
                }

                DashboardTab::Voice => {
                    ui.subheading("Paradee 8M Neural Text-to-Speech");
                    ui.label("Ultra-lightweight (8.5 MB) offline text-to-speech with natural prosody.");
                    ui.add_space(8.0);

                    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
                        ui.label("Voice:");
                        let voices = [
                            ("bf_isabella", "Isabella (British Female)"),
                            ("af_heart", "Heart (American Female)"),
                            ("am_puck", "Puck (American Male)"),
                            ("bm_fable", "Fable (British Male)"),
                        ];
                        for (id, label) in voices {
                            if ui.selectable_label(self.config.tts.voice_id == id, label).clicked() {
                                self.config.tts.voice_id = id.to_string();
                                self.tts.set_voice(id);
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    ui.add_space(8.0);
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label("Speech Speed:");
                        if ui
                            .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut self.config.tts.speed, 0.6..=2.5).suffix("x"))
                            .changed()
                        {
                            self.tts.set_speed(self.config.tts.speed);
                        }
                    });

                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label("Volume:");
                        if ui
                            .add(egui::Slider::new(&mut self.config.tts.volume, 0.0..=1.0))
                            .changed()
                        {
                            self.tts.set_volume(self.config.tts.volume);
                        }
                    });

                    ui.add_space(12.0);
                    ui.label("Test Playback:");
                    ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut self.test_text);
                    if ui.button("▶ Listen to Preview").clicked() {
                        self.tts.speak(&self.test_text);
                    }
                }

                DashboardTab::Bionic => {
                    ui.subheading("ADHD Bionic Reading Settings");
                    ui.label(
                        "Highlights the first few letters of words to guide the eye and improve reading focus.",
                    );
                    ui.add_space(8.0);

                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label("Fixation Ratio:");
                        ui.add(egui::Slider::new(&mut self.config.bionic.fixation_ratio, 0.2..=0.8));
                    });

                    ui.add_space(10.0);
                    ui.label("Native Windows Preview (In-Place Injection Format):");
                    let engine = crate::bionic::BionicEngine::new(self.config.bionic.fixation_ratio);
                    let preview = engine.to_unicode_bionic(
                        "Reading is the cognitive process of looking at written symbols and translating them into meaning.",
                    );
                    ui.add(
                        egui::Label::new(
                            egui::RichText::new(preview).color(egui::Color32::from_rgb(100, 180, 255)),
                        )
                        .wrap(true),
                    );
                }

                DashboardTab::Dictation => {
                    ui.subheading("Offline Speech-to-Text (NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B v3)");
                    ui.label("Completely offline, on-demand speech-to-text with zero cloud telemetry.");
                    ui.add_space(8.0);

                    let mut is_downloading = false;
                    let mut current_progress = 0.0;
                    let mut dl_status = String::new();

                    if let Some(rx) = &self.stt_rx {
                        let state = rx.borrow().clone();
                        match state {
                            DownloadState::NotInstalled => {}
                            DownloadState::Downloading {
                                progress,
                                bytes_downloaded,
                                total_bytes,
                                speed_bps,
                            } => {
                                is_downloading = true;
                                current_progress = progress;
                                dl_status = format!(
                                    "{:.1} MB / {:.1} MB ({:.2} MB/s)",
                                    bytes_downloaded as f32 / 1_000_000.0,
                                    total_bytes as f32 / 1_000_000.0,
                                    speed_bps as f32 / 1_000_000.0
                                );
                            }
                            DownloadState::VerifyingHash => {
                                is_downloading = true;
                                current_progress = 1.0;
                                dl_status = "Verifying SHA-256 hash integrity...".to_string();
                            }
                            DownloadState::Installed => {
                                self.config.stt.model_installed = true;
                            }
                            DownloadState::Error(err) => {
                                dl_status = format!("Download failed: {err}");
                            }
                            DownloadState::Paused { .. } => {}
                        }
                    }

                    let installed =
                        ModelDownloader::is_model_installed() || self.config.stt.model_installed;
                    if installed {
                        ui.colored_label(
                            egui::Color32::from_rgb(46, 204, 113),
                            "✓ Parakeet-TDT 0.6B Model is Installed & Ready",
                        );
                        ui.label(
                            "Hold your Push-to-Talk mouse button or press your keyboard shortcut to dictate anywhere on Windows.",
                        );
                    } else if is_downloading {
                        ui.label("Downloading NVIDIA Parakeet-TDT 0.6B model:");
                        ui.add(egui::ProgressBar::new(current_progress).show_percentage());
                        ui.label(&dl_status);
                        ctx.request_repaint();
                    } else {
                        ui.colored_label(
                            egui::Color32::from_rgb(230, 126, 34),
                            "Model is not yet downloaded (~600 MB INT8 ONNX)",
                        );
                        ui.label(
                            "Speech-to-text runs entirely offline on your GPU/CPU once downloaded.",
                        );
                        if ui.button("Download Model Now").clicked() {
                            let (downloader, rx) = ModelDownloader::new();
                            self.stt_rx = Some(rx);
                            let dl = Arc::new(downloader);
                            tokio::spawn(async move {
                                let _ = dl.start_download().await;
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                DashboardTab::Browsers => {
                    ui.subheading("Multi-Browser Extension Manager");
                    ui.label("Detected browsers and unpacked extension loader folders:");
                    ui.add_space(8.0);

                    for b in &self.browsers {
                        ui.group(|ui| {
                            ui.label(egui::RichText::new(b.name).strong());
                            ui.add(
                                egui::Label::new(format!("Extension Path: {:?}", b.extension_folder))
                                    .wrap(true),
                            );
                            ui.label(format!("Helper URL: {}", b.install_url));
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            ui.add_space(12.0);
            ui.separator();
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                if ui.button("Save All Settings").clicked() {
                    self.apply_and_save_shortcuts("All settings saved successfully.");
                }
                if let Some(msg) = &self.status_message {
                    ui.colored_label(egui::Color32::from_rgb(100, 200, 255), msg);
                }
            });
        });

        // Render modal keyboard shortcut editor if open
        self.render_keyboard_modal(ctx);
    }
}

            tts,
            current_sentence: String::new(),
            state: PlaybackState::Stopped,
        }
    }

    pub fn set_sentence(&mut self, sentence: String) {

    }

    }

impl eframe::App for FloatingPillHud {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, _frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        let frame = egui::Frame::none()
            .fill(egui::Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(25, 25, 30, 240))
            .rounding(egui::Rounding::same(24.0))
            .stroke(egui::Stroke::new(1.0_f32, egui::Color32::from_rgb(60, 60, 75)))
            .inner_margin(egui::Margin::symmetric(14.0, 8.0));

        egui::CentralPanel::default().frame(frame).show(ctx, |ui| {
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                // Play/Pause button
                let is_playing = self.state == PlaybackState::Playing;
                let play_pause_icon = if is_playing { "⏸" } else { "▶" };
                if ui.button(play_pause_icon).clicked() {
                    self.tts.toggle_pause();
                }

                // Stop button
                if ui.button("⏹").clicked() {
                    self.tts.stop();
                }

                ui.separator();

                // Sentence or status preview
                let preview = if !self.current_sentence.is_empty() {
                    let chars: String = self.current_sentence.chars().take(35).collect();
                    format!("\"{chars}...\"")
                } else if is_playing {
                    "Speaking...".to_string()
                } else {
                    "Ready".to_string()
                };

                ui.colored_label(egui::Color32::from_rgb(220, 220, 230), preview);
            });
        });
    }
}

use eframe::egui;
use std::sync::Arc;
use crate::audio::TtsEngine;
use crate::bionic::{BionicEngine, BionicToken};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ReaderTheme {
    Dark,
    Black,
    Sepia,
    Light,
}

impl ReaderTheme {
    pub fn bg_color(&self) -> egui::Color32 {
        match self {
            Self::Dark => egui::Color32::from_rgb(31, 31, 35),
            Self::Black => egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 0, 0),
            Self::Sepia => egui::Color32::from_rgb(244, 236, 216),
            Self::Light => egui::Color32::from_rgb(251, 251, 251),
        }
    }

    pub fn text_color(&self) -> egui::Color32 {
        match self {
            Self::Dark => egui::Color32::from_rgb(230, 230, 230),
            Self::Black => egui::Color32::from_rgb(222, 222, 222),
            Self::Sepia => egui::Color32::from_rgb(60, 50, 38),
            Self::Light => egui::Color32::from_rgb(34, 34, 34),
        }
    }

    pub fn bold_color(&self) -> egui::Color32 {
        match self {
            Self::Dark => egui::Color32::from_rgb(255, 255, 255),
            Self::Black => egui::Color32::from_rgb(255, 255, 255),
            Self::Sepia => egui::Color32::from_rgb(20, 15, 10),
            Self::Light => egui::Color32::from_rgb(0, 0, 0),
        }
    }

    pub fn toolbar_bg(&self) -> egui::Color32 {
        match self {
            Self::Dark => egui::Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(40, 40, 46, 240),
            Self::Black => egui::Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(20, 20, 20, 245),
            Self::Sepia => egui::Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(232, 222, 202, 240),
            Self::Light => egui::Color32::from_rgba_premultiplied(240, 240, 243, 240),
        }
    }
}

pub struct ReaderViewWindow {
    text: String,
    theme: ReaderTheme,
    font_size: f32,
    bionic_enabled: bool,
    fixation_ratio: f32,
    tts: Arc<TtsEngine>,
}

impl ReaderViewWindow {
    pub fn new(text: String, tts: Arc<TtsEngine>, fixation_ratio: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            text,
            theme: ReaderTheme::Dark,
            font_size: 19.0,
            bionic_enabled: true,
            fixation_ratio,
            tts,
        }
    }
}

impl eframe::App for ReaderViewWindow {
    fn update(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context, _frame: &mut eframe::Frame) {
        // Handle Escape key to exit
        if ctx.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::Escape)) {
            ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Close);
        }

        let bg = self.theme.bg_color();
        let text_color = self.theme.text_color();
        let bold_color = self.theme.bold_color();

        let panel_frame = egui::Frame::none().fill(bg).inner_margin(egui::Margin::symmetric(32.0, 24.0));

        egui::CentralPanel::default().frame(panel_frame).show(ctx, |ui| {
            // Floating Toolbar
            let toolbar_frame = egui::Frame::none()
                .fill(self.theme.toolbar_bg())
                .rounding(egui::Rounding::same(20.0))
                .inner_margin(egui::Margin::symmetric(14.0, 6.0));

            toolbar_frame.show(ui, |ui| {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    // Theme Switcher
                    ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Theme:").size(12.0).color(text_color));
                    let themes = [
                        (ReaderTheme::Dark, "Dark"),
                        (ReaderTheme::Black, "Black"),
                        (ReaderTheme::Sepia, "Sepia"),
                        (ReaderTheme::Light, "Light"),
                    ];
                    for (t, label) in themes {
                        if ui.selectable_label(self.theme == t, label).clicked() {
                            self.theme = t;
                        }
                    }

                    ui.separator();

                    // Font Size Controls
                    ui.label(egui::RichText::new("Size:").size(12.0).color(text_color));
                    if ui.button("A−").clicked() && self.font_size > 14.0 {
                        self.font_size -= 1.0;
                    }
                    ui.label(egui::RichText::new(format!("{:.0}px", self.font_size)).size(12.0).color(text_color));
                    if ui.button("A+").clicked() && self.font_size < 36.0 {
                        self.font_size += 1.0;
                    }

                    ui.separator();

                    // Bionic Toggle
                    let bionic_label = if self.bionic_enabled { "Bionic: ON" } else { "Bionic: OFF" };
                    if ui.selectable_label(self.bionic_enabled, bionic_label).clicked() {
                        self.bionic_enabled = !self.bionic_enabled;
                    }

                    ui.separator();

                    // Listen Aloud
                    if ui.button("▶ Listen").clicked() {
                        self.tts.speak(&self.text);
                    }

                    ui.with_layout(egui::Layout::right_to_left(egui::Align::Center), |ui| {
                        if ui.button("✕ Close (Esc)").clicked() {
                            ctx.send_viewport_cmd(egui::ViewportCommand::Close);
                        }
                    });
                });
            });

            ui.add_space(20.0);
            ui.separator();
            ui.add_space(16.0);

            // Article Content Scroll Area
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false; 2]).show(ui, |ui| {
                ui.style_mut().spacing.item_spacing.y = 12.0;

                if !self.bionic_enabled {
                    ui.label(
                        egui::RichText::new(&self.text)
                            .size(self.font_size)
                            .color(text_color)
                            .line_height(Some(self.font_size * 1.7)),
                    );
                } else {
                    // Render Bionic tokens
                    let engine = BionicEngine::new(self.fixation_ratio);
                    let paragraphs = self.text.split("\n\n");

                    for p in paragraphs {
                        if p.trim().is_empty() {
                            continue;
                        }
                        ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
                            ui.spacing_mut().item_spacing.x = 0.0;
                            let tokens = engine.tokenize(p);

                            for token in tokens {
                                match token {
                                    BionicToken::Word(w) => {
                                        ui.label(
                                            egui::RichText::new(&w.bold)
                                                .size(self.font_size)
                                                .strong()
                                                .color(bold_color),
                                        );
                                        ui.label(
                                            egui::RichText::new(&w.rest)
                                                .size(self.font_size)
                                                .color(text_color),
                                        );
                                    }
                                    BionicToken::NonWord(nw) => {
                                        ui.label(
                                            egui::RichText::new(&nw)
                                                .size(self.font_size)
                                                .color(text_color),
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        ui.add_space(8.0);
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    }
}



===== FILE: E:\Speak-That-Windows\src\ui\tray.rs =====
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::mem::size_of;
use tracing::info;
use windows::core::{w, PCWSTR};
use windows::Win32::Foundation::{HWND, LPARAM, LRESULT, POINT, WPARAM};
use windows::Win32::UI::Shell::{
    Shell_NotifyIconW, NIF_ICON, NIF_MESSAGE, NIF_TIP, NIM_ADD, NIM_DELETE, NOTIFYICONDATAW,
};
use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
    AppendMenuW, CreatePopupMenu, CreateWindowExW, DefWindowProcW, DestroyMenu, DispatchMessageW,
    GetCursorPos, GetMessageW, LoadIconW, RegisterClassW, SetForegroundWindow, TrackPopupMenu,
    TranslateMessage, IDI_APPLICATION, MF_SEPARATOR, MF_STRING, MSG, TPM_BOTTOMALIGN,
    TPM_LEFTALIGN, WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK, WM_RBUTTONUP, WNDCLASSW,
};

pub const WM_TRAYICON: u32 = 0x8000 + 100; // WM_APP + 100

pub const IDM_OPEN_DASHBOARD: usize = 1001;
pub const IDM_TOGGLE_BIONIC: usize = 1002;
pub const IDM_STOP_SPEECH: usize = 1003;
pub const IDM_EXIT: usize = 1004;

thread_local! {
    static GLOBAL_TRAY: RefCell<Option<TrayIcon>> = RefCell::new(None);
    static ACTION_CALLBACK: RefCell<Option<Box<dyn Fn(usize)>>> = RefCell::new(None);
}

pub struct TrayIcon {
    nid: NOTIFYICONDATAW,
}

impl TrayIcon {
    pub fn new(hwnd: HWND) -> Self {
        let mut nid = NOTIFYICONDATAW::default();
        nid.cbSize = size_of::<NOTIFYICONDATAW>() as u32;
        nid.hWnd = hwnd;
        nid.uID = 1;
        nid.uFlags = NIF_ICON | NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_TIP;
        nid.uCallbackMessage = WM_TRAYICON;

        unsafe {
            nid.hIcon = LoadIconW(None, IDI_APPLICATION).unwrap_or_default();
        }

        let tip = "SpeakThat + ADHD Bionic Reader";
        let tip_utf16: Vec<u16> = tip.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
        for (i, &c) in tip_utf16.iter().enumerate().take(127) {
            nid.szTip[i] = c;
        }

        unsafe {
            let _ = Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, &nid);
        }
        info!("System tray icon registered in Windows Notification Area");

        Self { nid }
    }

    pub fn show_context_menu(&self, hwnd: HWND) -> Option<usize> {
        unsafe {
            let menu = match CreatePopupMenu() {
                Ok(m) => m,
                Err(_) => return None,
            };

            let _ = AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, IDM_OPEN_DASHBOARD, windows::core::w!("Open Dashboard"));
            let _ = AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, IDM_TOGGLE_BIONIC, windows::core::w!("Toggle Bionic Reading"));
            let _ = AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, IDM_STOP_SPEECH, windows::core::w!("Stop Speaking"));
            let _ = AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, PCWSTR::null());
            let _ = AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, IDM_EXIT, windows::core::w!("Exit SpeakThat"));

            let mut pt = POINT::default();
            let _ = GetCursorPos(&mut pt);
            let _ = SetForegroundWindow(hwnd);

            let cmd = TrackPopupMenu(
                menu,
                TPM_LEFTALIGN | TPM_BOTTOMALIGN,
                pt.x,
                pt.y,
                0,
                hwnd,
                None,
            );

            let _ = DestroyMenu(menu);

            if cmd.0 != 0 {
                Some(cmd.0 as usize)
            } else {
                None
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for TrayIcon {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        unsafe {
            let _ = Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &self.nid);
        }
    }
}

unsafe extern "system" fn tray_wnd_proc(hwnd: HWND, msg: u32, wparam: WPARAM, lparam: LPARAM) -> LRESULT {
    if msg == WM_TRAYICON {
        let event = lparam.0 as u32;
        if event == WM_RBUTTONUP {
            GLOBAL_TRAY.with(|cell| {
                if let Some(tray) = cell.borrow().as_ref() {
                    if let Some(action) = tray.show_context_menu(hwnd) {
                        ACTION_CALLBACK.with(|cb_cell| {
                            if let Some(cb) = cb_cell.borrow().as_ref() {
                                cb(action);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
            return LRESULT(0);
        } else if event == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK {
            ACTION_CALLBACK.with(|cb_cell| {
                if let Some(cb) = cb_cell.borrow().as_ref() {
                    cb(IDM_OPEN_DASHBOARD);
                }
            });
            return LRESULT(0);
        }
    }

    DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam)
}

pub struct TrayManager;

impl TrayManager {
    pub fn spawn<F>(on_action: F)
    where
        F: Fn(usize) + Send + 'static,
    {
        std::thread::spawn(move || unsafe {
            let class_name = w!("SpeakThatTrayMsgClass");
            let mut wc = WNDCLASSW::default();
            wc.lpfnWndProc = Some(tray_wnd_proc);
            wc.lpszClassName = class_name;
            let _ = RegisterClassW(&wc);

            let hwnd = CreateWindowExW(
                Default::default(),
                class_name,
                w!("SpeakThatTrayWindow"),
                Default::default(),
                0,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                HWND(std::ptr::null_mut()),
                None,
                None,
                None,
            )
            .unwrap_or_default();

            if !hwnd.is_invalid() {
                let tray = TrayIcon::new(hwnd);
                GLOBAL_TRAY.with(|cell| {
                    *cell.borrow_mut() = Some(tray);
                });
                ACTION_CALLBACK.with(|cell| {
                    *cell.borrow_mut() = Some(Box::new(on_action));
                });

                let mut msg = MSG::default();
                while GetMessageW(&mut msg, None, 0, 0).as_bool() {
                    let _ = TranslateMessage(&msg);
                    DispatchMessageW(&msg);
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::time::Duration;

use crate::input::chord::{InputChord, ModifierKey, TriggerMode, TriggerSource};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AppConfig {
    pub tts: TtsSettings,
    pub stt: SttSettings,
    pub bionic: BionicSettings,
    pub shortcuts: ShortcutConfig,
    pub process_blacklist: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct BionicSettings {
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub fixation_ratio: f32,
    pub allowed_scripts: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TtsSettings {
    pub speed: f32,
    pub volume: f32,
    pub voice_id: String,
    pub auto_resume_after_dictation: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SttSettings {
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub model_installed: bool,
    pub hold_threshold_ms: u64,
    pub audio_ducking_db: f32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ActionBinding {
    pub keyboard: InputChord,
    pub mouse: Option<InputChord>,
}

impl ActionBinding {
    pub fn new(keyboard: InputChord, mouse: Option<InputChord>) -> Self {
        Self { keyboard, mouse }
    }

    pub fn matches_keyboard(&self, chord: &InputChord) -> bool {
        self.keyboard.matches(chord)
    }

    pub fn matches_mouse(&self, btn: u32) -> bool {
        if let Some(ref m) = self.mouse {
            matches!(m.trigger, TriggerSource::MouseButton(b) if b == btn)
        } else {
            false
        }
    }

    pub fn mouse_button(&self) -> Option<u32> {
        self.mouse.as_ref().and_then(|m| match m.trigger {
            TriggerSource::MouseButton(b) => Some(b),
            _ => None,
        })
    }

    pub fn mouse_hold_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        self.mouse
            .as_ref()
            .map(|m| match m.trigger_mode {
                TriggerMode::Hold(d) => d.as_millis() as u64,
                _ => 0,
            })
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }
}

pub fn default_stop_speaking() -> ActionBinding {
    ActionBinding::new(
        InputChord::new(
            vec![ModifierKey::Control, ModifierKey::Shift],
            TriggerSource::Key(0x58), // VK_X
            TriggerMode::Press,
        ),
        None,
    )
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ShortcutConfig {
    pub speak_selection: ActionBinding,
    #[serde(default = "default_stop_speaking")]
    pub stop_speaking: ActionBinding,
    pub push_to_talk: ActionBinding,
    pub open_home: ActionBinding,
    pub toggle_bionic: ActionBinding,
    pub toggle_reader: ActionBinding,
}

impl ShortcutConfig {
    /// Returns bitmask of bound mouse buttons (bit N = mouse button N)
    pub fn bound_mouse_mask(&self) -> u32 {
        let mut mask = 0u32;
        for b in [
            &self.speak_selection,
            &self.stop_speaking,
            &self.push_to_talk,
            &self.open_home,
            &self.toggle_bionic,
            &self.toggle_reader,
        ] {
            if let Some(btn) = b.mouse_button() {
                if btn < 32 {
                    mask |= 1u32 << btn;
                }
            }
        }
        mask
    }
}

impl AppConfig {
    pub fn config_path() -> PathBuf {
        let base = dirs::data_local_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
        base.join("SpeakThat").join("config.json")
    }

    pub fn load() -> Self {
        let path = Self::config_path();
        if path.exists() {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                if let Ok(config) = serde_json::from_str::<Self>(&content) {
                    if !content.contains("\"stop_speaking\"") {
                        let _ = config.save();
                    }
                    return config;
                }
            }
        }
        let default_config = Self::default();
        let _ = default_config.save();
        default_config
    }

    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let path = Self::config_path();
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent);
        }
        let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        fs::write(path, json).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(())
    }
}
