use ui::BrowserDetector;

fn load_app_icon() -> Option<eframe::egui::IconData> {
    eframe::icon_data::from_png_bytes(include_bytes!(
        "../brand/production/speakthat-symbol-app-icon-64.png"
    ))
    .ok()
}

fn format_binding_log(binding: &ActionBinding) -> String {
    match &binding.mouse {
        Some(m) => format!("Keyboard: [{}] | Mouse: [{}]", binding.keyboard, m),
        None => format!("Keyboard: [{}] | Mouse: [None]", binding.keyboard),
    }
}

struct InFlightReset(Arc<AtomicBool>);

impl Drop for InFlightReset {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.0.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
}

fn trigger_speak_selection(tts: Arc<TtsEngine>, in_flight: Arc<AtomicBool>) {
    if in_flight.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        tracing::debug!("Speak Selection capture already in flight; debouncing duplicate trigger.");
        return;
    }

    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let _reset = InFlightReset(in_flight);
        match SelectionCapture::capture_selected_text_synthetic(Duration::from_millis(300)).await {
            Ok(text) => {
                info!("Captured selected text: {} chars", text.len());
                tts.speak(&text);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("Could not capture selection: {}", e);
            }
        }
    });
}

fn trigger_bionic_transform(engine: Arc<BionicEngine>) {
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        match SelectionCapture::capture_selected_text_synthetic(Duration::from_millis(150)).await {
            Ok(text) => {
                let bionic_text = engine.to_unicode_bionic(&text);
                info!(
                    "Transformed {} chars to native Bionic Unicode format",
                    bionic_text.len()
                );
                if let Err(e) = TextInjector::inject_text(&bionic_text) {
                    warn!("Failed to inject bionic text: {}", e);
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                warn!("Could not capture selection for Bionic reading: {}", e);
            }
        }
    });
}

fn trigger_reader_view(tts: Arc<TtsEngine>, ratio: f32) {
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let text = match SelectionCapture::capture_selected_text_synthetic(Duration::from_millis(150)).await {
            Ok(t) if !t.trim().is_empty() => t,
            _ => "Highlight any text in any Windows app and press Alt+R to open it here in clean, distraction-free reader mode.\n\nYou can switch themes (Dark, OLED Black, Sepia, Light), scale font size, toggle Bionic reading, or listen aloud with neural speech.".to_string(),
        };

        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut viewport = eframe::egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
                .with_inner_size([800.0, 600.0])
                .with_min_inner_size([500.0, 400.0]);
            if let Some(icon) = load_app_icon() {
                viewport = viewport.with_icon(Arc::new(icon));
            }
            let native_options = eframe::NativeOptions {
                viewport,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let _ = eframe::run_native(
                "SpeakThat Native Reader View",
                native_options,
                Box::new(move |cc| {
                    ui::dashboard::configure_windows_fonts(&cc.egui_ctx);
                    Box::new(ui::ReaderViewWindow::new(text, tts, ratio))
                }),
            );
        });
    });
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // 1. Initialize logging
    tracing_subscriber::fmt()
        .with_env_filter("info,speakthat=debug")
        .init();

    info!("=== SpeakThat + ADHD Bionic Reader Suite v0.2.0 ===");
    info!("Starting native Windows client in Rust...");

    // 2. Load Configuration
    let config = AppConfig::load();
    info!("Configuration loaded from: {:?}", AppConfig::config_path());
    info!("Shortcuts bound (Keyboard + Mouse active simultaneously):");
    info!("  - Speak Selection: {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.speak_selection));
    info!("  - Stop Speaking (TTS): {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.stop_speaking));
    info!("  - Push-to-Talk (STT): {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.push_to_talk));
    info!("  - Open Home Dashboard: {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.open_home));
    info!("  - Toggle Bionic Reading: {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.toggle_bionic));
    info!("  - Toggle Reader View: {}", format_binding_log(&config.shortcuts.toggle_reader));

    // 3. Validate Shortcuts via Exact-Match Shortcut Collision Protection
    let checks = [
        ("Speak Selection", &config.shortcuts.speak_selection, false),
        ("Stop Speaking", &config.shortcuts.stop_speaking, false),
        ("Push-to-Talk", &config.shortcuts.push_to_talk, false),
        ("Open Home", &config.shortcuts.open_home, true),
        ("Toggle Bionic", &config.shortcuts.toggle_bionic, false),
        ("Toggle Reader", &config.shortcuts.toggle_reader, false),
    ];

    for (name, binding, allow_single) in checks {
        match ShortcutCatalog::validate_for(&binding.keyboard, allow_single) {
            input::CollisionSeverity::Allowed => {
                info!("  ✓ Shortcut [{}] validated: OK", name);
            }
            input::CollisionSeverity::Warning(msg) => {
                warn!("  Warning [{}]: {}", name, msg);
            }
            input::CollisionSeverity::HardBlocked(msg) => {
                warn!("  Blocked [{}]: {}", name, msg);
            }
        }
    }

    // 4. Multi-Browser Detection Manager
    let browsers = BrowserDetector::detect_all();
    info!("Detected {} installed browser(s):", browsers.len());
    for b in &browsers {
        info!("  - {} (Path: {:?})", b.name, b.executable_path);
        info!("    Extension Path: {:?}", b.extension_folder);
        info!("    Install helper: {}", b.install_url);
    }

    // 5. Build Tokio runtime for background workers
    let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_multi_thread()
        .enable_all()
        .build()?;
    let _guard = rt.enter();

    // 6. Initialize Audio & Bionic Engines
    let stt_installed = ModelDownloader::is_model_installed();
    info!(
        "Speech-to-Text (Parakeet-TDT 0.6B) Model Status: {}",
        if stt_installed {
            "Installed"
        } else {
            "Not Installed (On-Demand in-app download available)"
        }
    );

    let (tts_engine, _tts_rx) = TtsEngine::new();
    tts_engine.set_voice(&config.tts.voice_id);
    tts_engine.set_speed(config.tts.speed);
    tts_engine.set_volume(config.tts.volume);
    let (mic_manager, _ptt_rx, _duck_rx) = MicrophoneManager::new();
    let model_path = dirs::data_local_dir()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."))
        .join("SpeakThat")
        .join("models")
        .join("parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.onnx");
    let (stt_engine, _stt_rx) = SttEngine::new(model_path);
    let bionic_engine = BionicEngine::new(config.bionic.fixation_ratio);

    let tts_engine = Arc::new(tts_engine);
    let mic_manager = Arc::new(mic_manager);
    let _stt_engine = Arc::new(stt_engine);
    let bionic_engine = Arc::new(bionic_engine);

    // Shared hot-reloadable shortcut configuration
    let shared_shortcuts: Arc<RwLock<ShortcutConfig>> =
        Arc::new(RwLock::new(config.shortcuts.clone()));

    // 7. Initialize Low-Level Input Hooks & Mouse Bitmask
    InputHookManager::update_bound_mouse_mask(config.shortcuts.bound_mouse_mask());
    let (event_tx, mut event_rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel::<HookEvent>();
    let hook_mgr = Arc::new(InputHookManager::new(event_tx));
    let _hook_handle = hook_mgr.start_listening();
    info!("Low-level Windows keyboard and mouse hooks initialized.");

    // 8. Spawn background event receiver loop in Tokio (hot-reloads shared_shortcuts)
    let loop_shortcuts = Arc::clone(&shared_shortcuts);
    let loop_tts = Arc::clone(&tts_engine);
    let loop_bionic = Arc::clone(&bionic_engine);
    let loop_mic = Arc::clone(&mic_manager);
    let loop_ratio = config.bionic.fixation_ratio;
    let ptt_kb_active = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
    let speak_in_flight = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));

    rt.spawn(async move {
        while let Some(event) = event_rx.recv().await {
            let shortcuts = loop_shortcuts.read().unwrap().clone();

            match event {
                HookEvent::ChordTriggered(chord) => {
                    tracing::trace!("Key chord event received: {}", chord);

                    if shortcuts.speak_selection.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        info!("🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Speak Selection (Keyboard): {}", chord);
                        trigger_speak_selection(Arc::clone(&loop_tts), Arc::clone(&speak_in_flight));
                    } else if shortcuts.stop_speaking.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        info!("🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Stop Speaking: {}", chord);
                        loop_tts.stop();
                    } else if shortcuts.toggle_bionic.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        info!(
                            "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Native Bionic In-Place Transformation (Keyboard): {}",
                            chord
                        );
                        trigger_bionic_transform(Arc::clone(&loop_bionic));
                    } else if shortcuts.open_home.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        info!("🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Open Home Dashboard (Keyboard): {}", chord);
                    } else if shortcuts.toggle_reader.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        info!("🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Native Reader View (Keyboard): {}", chord);
                        trigger_reader_view(Arc::clone(&loop_tts), loop_ratio);
                    } else if shortcuts.push_to_talk.matches_keyboard(&chord) {
                        let was_active = ptt_kb_active.fetch_xor(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                        if !was_active {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Push-to-Talk Dictation (Keyboard Start): {}",
                                chord
                            );
                            loop_mic.on_ptt_press();
                        } else {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Push-to-Talk Dictation (Keyboard Stop): {}",
                                chord
                            );
                            loop_mic.on_ptt_release();
                        }
                    }
                }
                HookEvent::MouseButtonDown(btn) => {
                    tracing::debug!("Mouse button {} pressed", btn);
                    if shortcuts.push_to_talk.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        info!(
                            "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Push-to-Talk Dictation (Mouse Button {}): Start Listening",
                            btn
                        );
                        loop_mic.on_ptt_press();
                    }
                }
                HookEvent::MouseButtonUp(btn, duration) => {
                    let dur_ms = duration.as_millis() as u64;
                    tracing::debug!("Mouse button {} released after {}ms", btn, dur_ms);

                    if shortcuts.push_to_talk.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.push_to_talk.mouse_hold_ms();
                        info!(
                            "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Push-to-Talk Dictation (Mouse Button {}): Release ({}ms, threshold {}ms)",
                            btn, dur_ms, threshold
                        );
                        loop_mic.on_ptt_release();
                    } else if shortcuts.speak_selection.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.speak_selection.mouse_hold_ms();
                        if dur_ms >= threshold {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Speak Selection (Mouse Button {}, {}ms >= {}ms)",
                                btn, dur_ms, threshold
                            );
                            trigger_speak_selection(
                                Arc::clone(&loop_tts),
                                Arc::clone(&speak_in_flight),
                            );
                        } else {
                            info!(
                                "Mouse Button {} released before {}ms hold threshold ({}ms)",
                                btn, threshold, dur_ms
                            );
                        }
                    } else if shortcuts.stop_speaking.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.stop_speaking.mouse_hold_ms();
                        if dur_ms >= threshold {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Stop Speaking: Mouse Button {} ({}ms >= {}ms)",
                                btn, dur_ms, threshold
                            );
                            loop_tts.stop();
                        }
                    } else if shortcuts.toggle_bionic.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.toggle_bionic.mouse_hold_ms();
                        if dur_ms >= threshold {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Toggle Bionic Reading (Mouse Button {}, {}ms)",
                                btn, dur_ms
                            );
                            trigger_bionic_transform(Arc::clone(&loop_bionic));
                        }
                    } else if shortcuts.open_home.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.open_home.mouse_hold_ms();
                        if dur_ms >= threshold {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Open Home Dashboard (Mouse Button {}, {}ms)",
                                btn, dur_ms
                            );
                        }
                    } else if shortcuts.toggle_reader.matches_mouse(btn) {
                        let threshold = shortcuts.toggle_reader.mouse_hold_ms();
                        if dur_ms >= threshold {
                            info!(
                                "🔥 [HOTKEY MATCHED] Native Reader View (Mouse Button {}, {}ms)",
                                btn, dur_ms
                            );
                            trigger_reader_view(Arc::clone(&loop_tts), loop_ratio);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // 9. Initialize Windows System Tray Icon
    let tray_tts = Arc::clone(&tts_engine);
    let tray_bionic = Arc::clone(&bionic_engine);
    let _tray = ui::TrayManager::spawn(move |action| match action {
        ui::IDM_OPEN_DASHBOARD => {}
        ui::IDM_TOGGLE_BIONIC => {
            let engine = Arc::clone(&tray_bionic);
            let _ = std::thread::spawn(move || {
                let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().unwrap();
                rt.block_on(async {
                    if let Ok(text) =
                        SelectionCapture::capture_selected_text_synthetic(Duration::from_millis(150))
                            .await
                    {
                        let bionic_text = engine.to_unicode_bionic(&text);
                        let _ = TextInjector::inject_text(&bionic_text);
                    }
                });
            });
        }
        ui::IDM_STOP_SPEECH => {
            tray_tts.stop();
        }
        ui::IDM_EXIT => {
            std::process::exit(0);
        }
        _ => {}
    });

    info!("Application background services initialized. Launching egui Settings Dashboard on main thread...");

    // 10. Run egui Dashboard on the Main Thread with Custom Brand Icon
    let mut viewport = eframe::egui::ViewportBuilder::default()
        .with_inner_size([880.0, 620.0])
        .with_min_inner_size([760.0, 480.0]);
    if let Some(icon) = load_app_icon() {
        viewport = viewport.with_icon(Arc::new(icon));
        info!("Loaded custom SpeakThat brand icon for native window.");
    } else {
        warn!("Could not decode custom brand icon PNG; using default window icon.");
    }

    let native_options = eframe::NativeOptions {
        viewport,
        ..Default::default()
    };

    let gui_config = config.clone();
    let gui_shortcuts = Arc::clone(&shared_shortcuts);
    let gui_tts = Arc::clone(&tts_engine);
    eframe::run_native(
        "SpeakThat Settings Dashboard",
        native_options,
        Box::new(move |cc| {
            Box::new(ui::SettingsDashboard::new(
                cc,
                gui_config,
                gui_shortcuts,
                gui_tts,
            ))
        }),
    )
    .map_err(|e| Box::new(e) as Box<dyn std::error::Error>)?;

    Ok(())
}

chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(() => {
  chrome.contextMenus.create({
    id: "toggle-bionic-reading",
    title: "Toggle Bionic Reading",
    contexts: ["page", "selection"]
  });

// Context Menu: Toggle Bionic Reading
chrome.contextMenus.onClicked.addListener((info, tab) => {
  if (info.menuItemId === "toggle-bionic-reading") {
    chrome.storage.sync.get({ enabled: true }, (data) => {
      const nextState = !data.enabled;
      chrome.storage.sync.set({ enabled: nextState }, () => {
        chrome.storage.sync.get(null, (allSettings) => {
          broadcastSettings(allSettings);
        });
      });
    });
  }
});

// Keyboard Commands (Alt+B to toggle Bionic, Alt+R to toggle Reader)
chrome.commands.onCommand.addListener((command) => {
  if (command === "toggle-bionic") {
    chrome.storage.sync.get({ enabled: true }, (data) => {
      const nextState = !data.enabled;
      chrome.storage.sync.set({ enabled: nextState }, () => {
        chrome.storage.sync.get(null, (allSettings) => {
          broadcastSettings(allSettings);
        });
      });
    });
  } else if (command === "toggle-reader") {
    chrome.storage.sync.get({ readerModeEnabled: false }, (data) => {
      const nextState = !data.readerModeEnabled;
      chrome.storage.sync.set({ readerModeEnabled: nextState }, () => {
        chrome.storage.sync.get(null, (allSettings) => {
          broadcastSettings(allSettings);
        });
      });
    });
  }
});

function broadcastSettings(settings) {
  chrome.tabs.query({}, (tabs) => {
    tabs.forEach((tab) => {
      if (tab.id) {
        chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tab.id, { action: "settings_updated", settings }).catch(() => {});
      }
    });
  });
}

// ============================================================
// ADHD Bionic Reader - High Performance Content Script
// Built following The Modern Web Guidance:
// - Non-blocking task chunking via scheduler.yield()
// - Direct DOM text-node transformation (guaranteed visible bolding)
// - Clean reversibility (undoBionic restores pure DOM text)
// - Native C++ TreeWalker DOM traversal (O(N) single-pass)
// - Zero layout-thrashing: position:fixed floating TTS (no scroll queries)
// - Smart debounced MutationObserver with recursion guards
// ============================================================

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
  enabled: true,
  fixationRatio: 0.4,
  bionicBoldness: 1.0,
  blacklist: [],
  allowedScripts: ['Latin'],
  primaryMode: 'light',
  focusEnabled: false,
  bwEnabled: false,
  hcEnabled: false,
  nightLightEnabled: false,
  adhdEnabled: false,
  readerModeEnabled: false,
  readerTheme: 'auto',
  readerFontSize: 19
};

let currentSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS };
let isBionicActive = false;
let isTransforming = false;
let currentJobId = 0;
let observer = null;
let lastUrl = location.href;

// Tags and selectors to skip during text walk
const EXCLUDED_TAGS = new Set([
  'SCRIPT', 'STYLE', 'TEXTAREA', 'INPUT', 'SELECT', 'OPTION',
  'NOSCRIPT', 'CODE', 'PRE', 'SVG', 'CANVAS', 'VIDEO', 'AUDIO',
  'IFRAME', 'OBJECT', 'EMBED', 'MATH', 'ADHD-BORDER-HOST'
]);

// Non-blocking cooperative yield to browser main thread
async function yieldToMain() {
  if (typeof scheduler !== 'undefined' && typeof scheduler.yield === 'function') {
    return scheduler.yield();
  }
  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
}

// Word Fixation Length Calculation
function getBoldLength(word, ratio) {
  const len = word.length;
  if (len <= 1) return 1;
  if (len <= 3) return Math.min(len, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(len * ratio)));
  if (len === 4) return Math.min(3, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(len * ratio)));
  return Math.min(len - 1, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(len * ratio)));
}

// Compile word regex based on script settings
function getWordRegex() {
  const scripts = currentSettings.allowedScripts || ['Latin'];
  if (scripts.includes('Experimental (All other scripts)')) {
    return /([\p{L}\p{N}]+)|([^\p{L}\p{N}]+)/gu;
  }
  const scriptPattern = scripts.map(s => `\\p{Script=${s}}`).join('');
  return new RegExp(`([${scriptPattern}\\p{N}]+)|([^${scriptPattern}\\p{N}]+)`, 'gu');
}

// Transform a single text node into Bionic Reading elements
function bionicTransformTextNode(textNode, regex, ratio) {
  if (!textNode || !textNode.parentNode) return;
  const parent = textNode.parentNode;
  if (parent.closest && parent.closest('[data-bionic="1"], [data-bionic-bold="1"], [data-bionic-rest="1"], b[data-bionic="1"], adhd-border-host, #bionic-reader-overlay')) {
    return;
  }
  const text = textNode.nodeValue;
  if (!text || text.trim().length === 0) return;

  regex.lastIndex = 0;
  let hasMatch = false;
  let match;

  const wrapper = document.createElement('span');
  wrapper.setAttribute('data-bionic', '1');

  while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
    if (match[1]) {
      hasMatch = true;
      const word = match[1];
      const boldLen = getBoldLength(word, ratio);
      const boldPart = word.slice(0, boldLen);
      const restPart = word.slice(boldLen);

      const b = document.createElement('b');
      b.setAttribute('data-bionic-bold', '1');
      b.textContent = boldPart;
      wrapper.appendChild(b);

      if (restPart) {
        const restSpan = document.createElement('span');
        restSpan.setAttribute('data-bionic-rest', '1');
        restSpan.textContent = restPart;
        wrapper.appendChild(restSpan);
      }
    } else if (match[2]) {
      wrapper.appendChild(document.createTextNode(match[2]));
    }
  }

  if (hasMatch) {
    if (parent && textNode.parentNode === parent) {
      parent.replaceChild(wrapper, textNode);
    }
  }
}

// Revert all bionic bolding across a container
function undoBionic(container) {
  const root = container || document.body;
  if (!root) return;

  const bionicSpans = root.querySelectorAll('span[data-bionic="1"]');
  const parentsToNormalize = new Set();

  bionicSpans.forEach(span => {
    const parent = span.parentNode;
    if (parent) {
      parentsToNormalize.add(parent);
      span.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(span.textContent));
    }
  });

  const bElements = root.querySelectorAll('b[data-bionic="1"], b[data-bionic-bold="1"]');
  bElements.forEach(b => {
    const parent = b.parentNode;
    if (parent) {
      parentsToNormalize.add(parent);
      b.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(b.textContent));
    }
  });

  parentsToNormalize.forEach(p => {
    try {
      p.normalize();
    } catch (e) {}
  });
}

let fullPageJobId = 0;

// Non-blocking Tree Walker with scheduler.yield()
async function processSubtree(rootNode, isFullPage = false) {
  if (!currentSettings.enabled || isBlacklistedDomain()) return;
  if (!rootNode || !rootNode.isConnected) return;

  const jobId = isFullPage ? ++fullPageJobId : 0;
  const regex = getWordRegex();
  const ratio = currentSettings.fixationRatio || 0.4;

  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(
    rootNode,
    NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
    {
      acceptNode(node) {
        const val = node.nodeValue;
        if (!val || val.trim().length === 0) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        const parent = node.parentElement;
        if (!parent) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        const tag = parent.tagName;
        if (EXCLUDED_TAGS.has(tag)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        if (parent.closest && parent.closest('[data-bionic="1"], [data-bionic-bold="1"], [data-bionic-rest="1"], b[data-bionic], adhd-border-host, #bionic-reader-overlay, [contenteditable="true"]')) {
          return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        }
        if (parent.isContentEditable) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
      }
    }
  );

  const textNodes = [];
  while (walker.nextNode()) {
    textNodes.push(walker.currentNode);
  }

  // Chunk processing: 6ms budget per frame to preserve 60fps (INP < 16ms)
  let i = 0;
  const total = textNodes.length;
  isTransforming = true;

  try {
    while (i < total) {
      if (isFullPage && jobId !== fullPageJobId) return; // Stale full-page job cancelled

      const startPerf = performance.now();
      while (i < total && (performance.now() - startPerf) < 6) {
        const textNode = textNodes[i++];
        if (textNode && textNode.isConnected && textNode.parentNode) {
          bionicTransformTextNode(textNode, regex, ratio);
        }
      }

      if (i < total) {
        await yieldToMain();
      }
    }
  } finally {
    isTransforming = false;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MUTATION OBSERVER (Batched, Debounced, No Layout Thrashing)
// ============================================================

let mutationQueue = new Set();
let mutationTimeout = null;

function handleMutations(mutations) {
  checkUrlChange();
  if (!currentSettings.enabled || isBlacklistedDomain()) return;

  let hasAdded = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
    const mutation = mutations[i];

    for (let k = 0; k < mutation.addedNodes.length; k++) {
      const added = mutation.addedNodes[k];
      if (added.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
        const tag = added.tagName;
        if (tag === 'HEAD' || EXCLUDED_TAGS.has(tag)) continue;
        if (added.hasAttribute && (added.hasAttribute('data-bionic') || added.hasAttribute('data-bionic-bold') || added.hasAttribute('data-bionic-rest'))) continue;
        if (added.closest && added.closest('[data-bionic="1"], [data-bionic-bold="1"], [data-bionic-rest="1"], adhd-border-host, #bionic-reader-overlay')) continue;
        mutationQueue.add(added);
        hasAdded = true;
      } else if (added.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        const parent = added.parentElement;
        if (parent && !EXCLUDED_TAGS.has(parent.tagName)) {
          if (!parent.closest || !parent.closest('[data-bionic="1"], [data-bionic-bold="1"], [data-bionic-rest="1"], adhd-border-host, #bionic-reader-overlay')) {
            mutationQueue.add(added);
            hasAdded = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (hasAdded) {
    if (mutationTimeout) clearTimeout(mutationTimeout);
    mutationTimeout = setTimeout(flushMutationQueue, 150);
  }
}

async function flushMutationQueue() {
  if (mutationQueue.size === 0) return;
  const nodes = Array.from(mutationQueue);
  mutationQueue.clear();

  const regex = getWordRegex();
  const ratio = currentSettings.fixationRatio || 0.4;

  // Deduplicate nested elements
  const topNodes = nodes.filter(node => {
    let parent = node.parentNode;
    while (parent && parent !== document.body && parent !== document.documentElement) {
      if (nodes.includes(parent)) return false;
      parent = parent.parentNode;
    }
    return true;
  });

  for (const node of topNodes) {
    if (node.isConnected) {
      if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        bionicTransformTextNode(node, regex, ratio);
      } else {
        await processSubtree(node, false);
      }
    }
  }
}

function startObserver() {
  if (observer) return;
  observer = new MutationObserver(handleMutations);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement || document.body, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });
}

function stopObserver() {
  if (observer) {
    observer.disconnect();
    observer = null;
  }
  if (mutationTimeout) clearTimeout(mutationTimeout);
  mutationQueue.clear();
}

function isBlacklistedDomain() {
  return currentSettings.blacklist && currentSettings.blacklist.includes(window.location.hostname);
}

function checkUrlChange() {
  if (lastUrl !== location.href) {
    lastUrl = location.href;
    if (isBlacklistedDomain() || !currentSettings.enabled) {
      undoBionic(document.body);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (document.body) processSubtree(document.body);
      }, 300);
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// DYNAMIC BIONIC CSS STYLES
// ============================================================

function injectStyles(settings) {
  let style = document.getElementById('bionic-styles');
  if (!style) {
    style = document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'bionic-styles';
    style.setAttribute('data-darkreader-ignore', 'true');
    const target = document.head || document.documentElement;
    if (target) target.appendChild(style);
  }

  const boldness = settings ? (settings.bionicBoldness || 1.0) : 1.0;
  let fontWeight = 800;
  let strokeCSS = '';

  if (boldness >= 2.0) {
    fontWeight = 900;
    const strokeWidth = ((boldness - 1.5) * 0.35).toFixed(2);
    strokeCSS = `-webkit-text-stroke: ${strokeWidth}px currentColor;`;
  } else if (boldness > 1.0) {
    fontWeight = 850;
    const strokeWidth = ((boldness - 1.0) * 0.25).toFixed(2);
    strokeCSS = `-webkit-text-stroke: ${strokeWidth}px currentColor;`;
  } else if (boldness < 0.8) {
    fontWeight = 700;
  }

  style.textContent = `
    span[data-bionic="1"] {
      display: inline !important;
      font-weight: 400 !important;
      color: inherit !important;
    }
    span[data-bionic-rest="1"] {
      display: inline !important;
      font-weight: 400 !important;
      color: inherit !important;
    }
    b[data-bionic-bold="1"], b[data-bionic="1"] {
      font-weight: ${fontWeight} !important;
      display: inline !important;
      color: inherit !important;
      ${strokeCSS}
    }
  `;
}

let adhdBorderHost = null;

function applyVisualSettings(settings) {
  removeADHDOverlays();

  const mode = settings.primaryMode || 'light';

  if (typeof DarkReader !== 'undefined') {
    const isDarkReaderNeeded = (mode === 'gray' || mode === 'black' || settings.bwEnabled || settings.nightLightEnabled || settings.hcEnabled);

    if (isDarkReaderNeeded) {
      const theme = {
        brightness: 100,
        contrast: settings.hcEnabled ? 140 : 100,
        sepia: settings.nightLightEnabled ? 35 : 0,
        grayscale: settings.bwEnabled ? 100 : 0,
        mode: (mode === 'gray' || mode === 'black') ? 1 : 0
      };

      if (mode === 'gray') {
        theme.darkSchemeBackgroundColor = '#2e2e2e';
        theme.darkSchemeTextColor = '#e0e0e0';
      } else if (mode === 'black') {
        theme.darkSchemeBackgroundColor = '#000000';
        theme.darkSchemeTextColor = '#e0e0e0';
      }

      try {
        DarkReader.setFetchMethod(window.fetch);
        DarkReader.enable(theme);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[ADHD Bionic Reader] DarkReader enable:', e);
      }
    } else {
      try {
        DarkReader.disable();
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  // Focus Engine
  let focusStyleEl = document.getElementById('adhd-focus-engine');
  if (settings.focusEnabled) {
    if (!focusStyleEl) {
      focusStyleEl = document.createElement('style');
      focusStyleEl.id = 'adhd-focus-engine';
      const target = document.head || document.documentElement;
      if (target) target.appendChild(focusStyleEl);
    }
    focusStyleEl.textContent = `
      img:not([alt*="logo" i]), video, iframe, [class*="ad-" i], [id*="ad-" i] {
        opacity: 0.1 !important;
        filter: grayscale(100%) !important;
        transition: opacity 0.25s ease !important;
      }
      img:hover, video:hover, iframe:hover {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        filter: none !important;
      }
    `;
  } else if (focusStyleEl) {
    focusStyleEl.remove();
  }

  // ADHD Peripheral Breathing Border
  if (settings.adhdEnabled) {
    setupADHDOverlays();
  }
}

function setupADHDOverlays() {
  if (adhdBorderHost) return;
  adhdBorderHost = document.createElement('adhd-border-host');
  adhdBorderHost.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; z-index: 2147483646; pointer-events: none;';

  const shadow = adhdBorderHost.attachShadow({ mode: 'closed' });
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

  const style = document.createElement('style');

      background-size: 200% 100%;

    .top { top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 5px; }

    .right { top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 5px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2196F3, #9C27B0, #2196F3); background-size: 100% 200%; }

  wrapper.appendChild(style);
  wrapper.appendChild(t);
  wrapper.appendChild(b);
  wrapper.appendChild(l);
  wrapper.appendChild(r);
  shadow.appendChild(wrapper);

  (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(adhdBorderHost);
}

function removeADHDOverlays() {
  if (adhdBorderHost) {
    adhdBorderHost.remove();
    adhdBorderHost = null;
  }
}

function resolveReaderTheme(themeSetting) {
  if (themeSetting && themeSetting !== 'auto') {
    return themeSetting;
  }
  if (currentSettings.primaryMode === 'black') return 'black';
  if (currentSettings.primaryMode === 'gray') return 'dark';
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
    return 'dark';
  }
  return 'light';
}

function disableReaderMode() {
  if (!readerModeOverlay) return;

  Array.from(document.body.children).forEach(child => {
    if (child.dataset.bionicPrevDisplay !== undefined) {
      child.style.display = child.dataset.bionicPrevDisplay;
      delete child.dataset.bionicPrevDisplay;
    }
  });

  readerModeOverlay.remove();
  readerModeOverlay = null;
}

// ============================================================
// SETTINGS APPLICATION LIFECYCLE
// ============================================================

async function applySettingsAndRender(settings, isInitial = false) {
  const prevSettings = { ...currentSettings };
  currentSettings = settings;

  injectStyles(currentSettings);
  applyVisualSettings(currentSettings);

  const isBlacklisted = isBlacklistedDomain();
  const shouldBeActive = currentSettings.enabled && !isBlacklisted;

  if (shouldBeActive) {
    if (currentSettings.readerModeEnabled) {
      enableReaderMode();
    } else {
      disableReaderMode();
    }

    const needsRehighlight = isInitial || (
      !isBionicActive ||
      prevSettings.fixationRatio !== currentSettings.fixationRatio ||
      JSON.stringify(prevSettings.allowedScripts) !== JSON.stringify(currentSettings.allowedScripts)
    );

    if (needsRehighlight) {
      if (!isInitial) {
        undoBionic(document.body);
      }
      isBionicActive = true;
      if (document.body) {
        await processSubtree(document.body, true);
      }
    }

    startObserver();
  } else {
    disableReaderMode();
    stopObserver();
    undoBionic(document.body);
    isBionicActive = false;
  }
}

// Runtime messaging listener
chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (request.action === "ping") {
    sendResponse({ status: "ok" });
  } else if (request.action === "settings_updated" && request.settings) {
    applySettingsAndRender(request.settings);
  }
});

// SPA URL change detection via History API
const nativePushState = history.pushState;
history.pushState = function() {
  nativePushState.apply(this, arguments);
  checkUrlChange();
};

const nativeReplaceState = history.replaceState;
history.replaceState = function() {
  nativeReplaceState.apply(this, arguments);
  checkUrlChange();
};

window.addEventListener('popstate', checkUrlChange);

// Initialize on page load (Robust dual-stage with zero cold-start delay)
let hasInitialized = false;

function initPage(settings) {
  if (hasInitialized) return;
  hasInitialized = true;
  applySettingsAndRender(settings || currentSettings, true);
}

if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.sync) {
  try {
    chrome.storage.sync.get(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, (settings) => {
      const merged = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...settings };
      if (!hasInitialized) {
        initPage(merged);
      } else {
        applySettingsAndRender(merged, false);
      }
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[ADHD Bionic Reader] storage.sync error:', e);
  }
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => initPage(), { once: true });
} else {
  // Run on next tick if DOM is already parsed/interactive
  setTimeout(() => initPage(), 0);
}

    async function getOKResponse(url, mimeType, origin) {
        const credentials =
            origin && url.startsWith(`${origin}/`) ? undefined : "omit";
        const response = await fetch(url, {
            cache: "force-cache",
            credentials,
            referrer: origin
        });
        if (
            isFirefox &&
            mimeType === "text/css" &&
            url.startsWith("moz-extension://") &&
            url.endsWith(".css")
        ) {
            return response;
        }
        if (
            mimeType &&
            !response.headers.get("Content-Type").startsWith(mimeType)
        ) {
            throw new Error(`Mime type mismatch when loading ${url}`);
        }
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unable to load ${url} ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`
            );
        }
        return response;
    }
    async function loadAsDataURL(url, mimeType) {
        const response = await getOKResponse(url, mimeType);
        return await readResponseAsDataURL(response);
    }
    async function loadAsBlob(url, mimeType) {
        const response = await getOKResponse(url, mimeType);
        return await response.blob();
    }
    async function readResponseAsDataURL(response) {
        const blob = await response.blob();
        const dataURL = await new Promise((resolve) => {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onloadend = () => resolve(reader.result);
            reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
        });
        return dataURL;
    }
    async function loadAsText(url, mimeType, origin) {
        const response = await getOKResponse(url, mimeType, origin);
        return await response.text();
    }

    async function sendMessage(...args) {
        if (args[0] && args[0].type === MessageTypeCStoBG.FETCH) {
            const {id} = args[0];
            try {
                const {url, responseType} = args[0].data;
                const response = await callFetchMethod(url);
                let text;
                if (responseType === "data-url") {
                    text = await readResponseAsDataURL(response);
                } else {
                    text = await response.text();
                }
                messageListeners.forEach((cb) =>
                    cb({
                        type: MessageTypeBGtoCS.FETCH_RESPONSE,
                        data: text,
                        error: null,
                        id
                    })
                );
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(error);
                messageListeners.forEach((cb) =>
                    cb({
                        type: MessageTypeBGtoCS.FETCH_RESPONSE,
                        data: null,
                        error,
                        id
                    })
                );
            }
        }
    }

    function isArrayLike(items) {
        return items.length != null;
    }
    function forEach(items, iterator) {
        if (isArrayLike(items)) {
            for (let i = 0, len = items.length; i < len; i++) {
                iterator(items[i]);
            }
        } else {
            for (const item of items) {
                iterator(item);
            }
        }
    }
    function push(array, addition) {
        forEach(addition, (a) => array.push(a));
    }
    function toArray(items) {
        const results = [];
        for (let i = 0, len = items.length; i < len; i++) {
            results.push(items[i]);
        }
        return results;
    }

    function throttle(callback) {
        let pending = false;
        let frameId = null;
        let lastArgs;
        const throttled = (...args) => {
            lastArgs = args;
            if (frameId) {
                pending = true;
            } else {
                callback(...lastArgs);
                frameId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    frameId = null;
                    if (pending) {
                        callback(...lastArgs);
                        pending = false;
                    }
                });
            }
        };
        const cancel = () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
            pending = false;
            frameId = null;
        };
        return Object.assign(throttled, {cancel});
    }
    function createAsyncTasksQueue() {
        const tasks = [];
        let frameId = null;
        function runTasks() {
            let task;
            while ((task = tasks.shift())) {
                task();
            }
            frameId = null;
        }
        function add(task) {
            tasks.push(task);
            if (!frameId) {
                frameId = requestAnimationFrame(runTasks);
            }
        }
        function cancel() {
            tasks.splice(0);
            cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
            frameId = null;
        }
        return {add, cancel};
    }
    const delayTokens = new Set();
    function requestAnimationFrameOnce(token, callback) {
        if (delayTokens.has(token)) {
            return;
        }
        delayTokens.add(token);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            delayTokens.delete(token);
            callback();
        });
    }

    function getDuration(time) {
        let duration = 0;
        if (time.seconds) {
            duration += time.seconds * 1000;
        }
        if (time.minutes) {
            duration += time.minutes * 60 * 1000;
        }
        if (time.hours) {
            duration += time.hours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        }
        if (time.days) {
            duration += time.days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        }
        return duration;
    }

    function removeNode(node) {
        node && node.parentNode && node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
    }
    function watchForNodePosition(node, mode, onRestore = Function.prototype) {
        const MAX_ATTEMPTS_COUNT = 10;
        const RETRY_TIMEOUT = getDuration({seconds: 2});
        const ATTEMPTS_INTERVAL = getDuration({seconds: 10});
        const prevSibling = node.previousSibling;
        let parent = node.parentNode;
        if (!parent) {
            throw new Error(
                "Unable to watch for node position: parent element not found"
            );
        }
        if (mode === "prev-sibling" && !prevSibling) {
            throw new Error(
                "Unable to watch for node position: there is no previous sibling"
            );
        }
        let attempts = 0;
        let start = null;
        let timeoutId = null;
        const restore = throttle(() => {
            if (timeoutId) {
                return;
            }
            attempts++;
            const now = Date.now();
            if (start == null) {
                start = now;
            } else if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS_COUNT) {
                if (now - start < ATTEMPTS_INTERVAL) {
                    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                        start = null;
                        attempts = 0;
                        timeoutId = null;
                        restore();
                    }, RETRY_TIMEOUT);
                    return;
                }
                start = now;
                attempts = 1;
            }
            if (mode === "head") {
                if (prevSibling && prevSibling.parentNode !== parent) {
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (mode === "prev-sibling") {
                if (prevSibling.parentNode == null) {
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                if (prevSibling.parentNode !== parent) {
                    updateParent(prevSibling.parentNode);
                }
            }
            if (mode === "head" && !parent.isConnected) {
                parent = document.head;
            }
            parent.insertBefore(
                node,
                prevSibling && prevSibling.isConnected
                    ? prevSibling.nextSibling
                    : parent.firstChild
            );
            observer.takeRecords();
            onRestore && onRestore();
        });
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (
                (mode === "head" &&
                    (node.parentNode !== parent ||
                        !node.parentNode.isConnected)) ||
                (mode === "prev-sibling" &&
                    node.previousSibling !== prevSibling)
            ) {
                restore();
            }
        });
        const run = () => {
            observer.observe(parent, {childList: true});
        };
        const stop = () => {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            observer.disconnect();
            restore.cancel();
        };
        const skip = () => {
            observer.takeRecords();
        };
        const updateParent = (parentNode) => {
            parent = parentNode;
            stop();
            run();
        };
        run();
        return {run, stop, skip};
    }
    function iterateShadowHosts(root, iterator) {
        if (root == null) {
            return;
        }
        const walker = document.createTreeWalker(
            root,
            NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT,
            {
                acceptNode(node) {
                    return node.shadowRoot == null
                        ? NodeFilter.FILTER_SKIP
                        : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
                }
            }
        );
        for (
            let node = root.shadowRoot ? walker.currentNode : walker.nextNode();
            node != null;
            node = walker.nextNode()
        ) {
            if (node.classList.contains("surfingkeys_hints_host")) {
                continue;
            }
            iterator(node);
            iterateShadowHosts(node.shadowRoot, iterator);
        }
    }
    let isDOMReady = () => {

    const readyStateListeners = new Set();
    function addDOMReadyListener(listener) {

    function isReadyStateComplete() {

    const readyStateCompleteListeners = new Set();
    function addReadyStateCompleteListener(listener) {
        isReadyStateComplete()
            ? listener()
            : readyStateCompleteListeners.add(listener);
    }
    function cleanReadyStateCompleteListeners() {
        readyStateCompleteListeners.clear();
    }
    if (!isDOMReady()) {
        const onReadyStateChange = () => {
            if (isDOMReady()) {
                readyStateListeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
                readyStateListeners.clear();
                if (isReadyStateComplete()) {
                    document.removeEventListener(
                        "readystatechange",
                        onReadyStateChange

                    readyStateCompleteListeners.forEach((listener) =>
                        listener()
                    );
                    readyStateCompleteListeners.clear();
                }
            }
        };

    }
    const HUGE_MUTATIONS_COUNT = 1000;
    function isHugeMutation(mutations) {
        if (mutations.length > HUGE_MUTATIONS_COUNT) {
            return true;
        }
        let addedNodesCount = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
            addedNodesCount += mutations[i].addedNodes.length;
            if (addedNodesCount > HUGE_MUTATIONS_COUNT) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    function getElementsTreeOperations(mutations) {
        const additions = new Set();
        const deletions = new Set();
        const moves = new Set();
        mutations.forEach((m) => {
            forEach(m.addedNodes, (n) => {
                if (n instanceof Element && n.isConnected) {
                    additions.add(n);
                }
            });
            forEach(m.removedNodes, (n) => {
                if (n instanceof Element) {
                    if (n.isConnected) {
                        moves.add(n);
                        additions.delete(n);
                    } else {
                        deletions.add(n);
                    }
                }
            });
        });
        const duplicateAdditions = [];
        const duplicateDeletions = [];
        additions.forEach((node) => {
            if (additions.has(node.parentElement)) {
                duplicateAdditions.push(node);
            }
        });
        deletions.forEach((node) => {
            if (deletions.has(node.parentElement)) {
                duplicateDeletions.push(node);
            }
        });
        duplicateAdditions.forEach((node) => additions.delete(node));
        duplicateDeletions.forEach((node) => deletions.delete(node));
        return {additions, moves, deletions};
    }
    const optimizedTreeObservers = new Map();
    const optimizedTreeCallbacks = new WeakMap();
    function createOptimizedTreeObserver(root, callbacks) {
        let observer;
        let observerCallbacks;
        let domReadyListener;
        if (optimizedTreeObservers.has(root)) {
            observer = optimizedTreeObservers.get(root);
            observerCallbacks = optimizedTreeCallbacks.get(observer);
        } else {
            let hadHugeMutationsBefore = false;
            let subscribedForReadyState = false;
            observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
                if (isHugeMutation(mutations)) {
                    if (!hadHugeMutationsBefore || isDOMReady()) {
                        observerCallbacks.forEach(({onHugeMutations}) =>
                            onHugeMutations(root)
                        );
                    } else if (!subscribedForReadyState) {
                        domReadyListener = () =>
                            observerCallbacks.forEach(({onHugeMutations}) =>
                                onHugeMutations(root)
                            );
                        addDOMReadyListener(domReadyListener);
                        subscribedForReadyState = true;
                    }
                    hadHugeMutationsBefore = true;
                } else {
                    const elementsOperations =
                        getElementsTreeOperations(mutations);
                    observerCallbacks.forEach(({onMinorMutations}) =>
                        onMinorMutations(root, elementsOperations)
                    );
                }
            });
            observer.observe(root, {childList: true, subtree: true});
            optimizedTreeObservers.set(root, observer);
            observerCallbacks = new Set();
            optimizedTreeCallbacks.set(observer, observerCallbacks);
        }
        observerCallbacks.add(callbacks);
        return {
            disconnect() {
                observerCallbacks.delete(callbacks);
                if (domReadyListener) {
                    removeDOMReadyListener(domReadyListener);
                }
                if (observerCallbacks.size === 0) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    optimizedTreeCallbacks.delete(observer);
                    optimizedTreeObservers.delete(root);
                }
            }
        };
    }

    function getMatches(regex, input, group = 0) {
        const matches = [];
        let m;
        while ((m = regex.exec(input))) {
            matches.push(m[group]);
        }
        return matches;
    }
    function getHashCode(text) {
        const len = text.length;
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
            hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + c) & 4294967295;
        }
        return hash;
    }
    function escapeRegExpSpecialChars(input) {
        return input.replaceAll(/[\^$.*+?\(\)\[\]{}|\-\\]/g, "\\$&");
    }
    function getParenthesesRange(input, searchStartIndex = 0) {
        return getOpenCloseRange(input, searchStartIndex, "(", ")", []);
    }
    function getOpenCloseRange(
        input,
        searchStartIndex,
        openToken,
        closeToken,
        excludeRanges
    ) {
        let indexOf;
        if (excludeRanges.length === 0) {
            indexOf = (token, pos) => input.indexOf(token, pos);
        } else {
            indexOf = (token, pos) =>
                indexOfExcluding(input, token, pos, excludeRanges);
        }
        const {length} = input;
        let depth = 0;
        let firstOpenIndex = -1;
        for (let i = searchStartIndex; i < length; i++) {
            if (depth === 0) {
                const openIndex = indexOf(openToken, i);
                if (openIndex < 0) {
                    break;
                }
                firstOpenIndex = openIndex;
                depth++;
                i = openIndex;
            } else {
                const closeIndex = indexOf(closeToken, i);
                if (closeIndex < 0) {
                    break;
                }
                const openIndex = indexOf(openToken, i);
                if (openIndex < 0 || closeIndex <= openIndex) {
                    depth--;
                    if (depth === 0) {
                        return {start: firstOpenIndex, end: closeIndex + 1};
                    }
                    i = closeIndex;
                } else {
                    depth++;
                    i = openIndex;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function indexOfExcluding(input, search, position, excludeRanges) {
        const i = input.indexOf(search, position);
        const exclusion = excludeRanges.find((r) => i >= r.start && i < r.end);
        if (exclusion) {
            return indexOfExcluding(
                input,
                search,
                exclusion.end,
                excludeRanges
            );
        }
        return i;
    }
    function splitExcluding(input, separator, excludeRanges) {
        const parts = [];
        let commaIndex = -1;
        let currIndex = 0;
        while (
            (commaIndex = indexOfExcluding(
                input,
                separator,
                currIndex,
                excludeRanges
            )) >= 0
        ) {
            parts.push(input.substring(currIndex, commaIndex).trim());
            currIndex = commaIndex + 1;
        }
        parts.push(input.substring(currIndex).trim());
        return parts;
    }

    let anchor;
    const parsedURLCache = new Map();
    function fixBaseURL($url) {
        if (!anchor) {
            anchor = document.createElement("a");
        }
        anchor.href = $url;
        return anchor.href;
    }
    function parseURL($url, $base = null) {
        const key = `${$url}${$base ? `;${$base}` : ""}`;
        if (parsedURLCache.has(key)) {
            return parsedURLCache.get(key);
        }
        if ($base) {
            const parsedURL = new URL($url, fixBaseURL($base));
            parsedURLCache.set(key, parsedURL);
            return parsedURL;
        }
        const parsedURL = new URL(fixBaseURL($url));
        parsedURLCache.set($url, parsedURL);
        return parsedURL;
    }
    function getAbsoluteURL($base, $relative) {
        if ($relative.match(/^data\\?\:/)) {
            return $relative;
        }
        if (/^\/\//.test($relative)) {
            return `${location.protocol}${$relative}`;
        }
        const b = parseURL($base);
        const a = parseURL($relative, b.href);
        return a.href;
    }
    function isRelativeHrefOnAbsolutePath(href) {
        if (href.startsWith("data:")) {
            return true;
        }
        const url = parseURL(href);
        if (url.protocol !== location.protocol) {
            return false;
        }
        if (url.hostname !== location.hostname) {
            return false;
        }
        if (url.port !== location.port) {
            return false;
        }
        return url.pathname === location.pathname;
    }

    function iterateCSSRules(rules, iterate, onImportError) {
        forEach(rules, (rule) => {
            if (isStyleRule(rule)) {
                iterate(rule);
            } else if (isImportRule(rule)) {
                try {
                    iterateCSSRules(
                        rule.styleSheet.cssRules,
                        iterate,
                        onImportError
                    );
                } catch (err) {
                    onImportError?.();
                }
            } else if (isMediaRule(rule)) {
                const media = Array.from(rule.media);
                const isScreenOrAllOrQuery = media.some(
                    (m) =>
                        m.startsWith("screen") ||
                        m.startsWith("all") ||
                        m.startsWith("(")
                );
                const isPrintOrSpeech = media.some(
                    (m) => m.startsWith("print") || m.startsWith("speech")
                );
                if (isScreenOrAllOrQuery || !isPrintOrSpeech) {
                    iterateCSSRules(rule.cssRules, iterate, onImportError);
                }
            } else if (isSupportsRule(rule)) {
                if (CSS.supports(rule.conditionText)) {
                    iterateCSSRules(rule.cssRules, iterate, onImportError);
                }
            } else if (isLayerRule(rule)) {
                iterateCSSRules(rule.cssRules, iterate, onImportError);
            } else;
        });
    }
    const shorthandVarDependantProperties = [
        "background",
        "border",
        "border-color",
        "border-bottom",
        "border-left",
        "border-right",
        "border-top",
        "outline",
        "outline-color"
    ];
    const shorthandVarDepPropRegexps = isSafari
        ? shorthandVarDependantProperties.map((prop) => {
              const regexp = new RegExp(`${prop}:\\s*(.*?)\\s*;`);
              return [prop, regexp];
          })
        : null;
    function iterateCSSDeclarations(style, iterate) {
        forEach(style, (property) => {
            const value = style.getPropertyValue(property).trim();
            if (!value) {
                return;
            }
            iterate(property, value);
        });
        const cssText = style.cssText;
        if (cssText.includes("var(")) {
            if (isSafari) {
                shorthandVarDepPropRegexps.forEach(([prop, regexp]) => {
                    const match = cssText.match(regexp);
                    if (match && match[1]) {
                        const val = match[1].trim();
                        iterate(prop, val);
                    }
                });
            } else {
                shorthandVarDependantProperties.forEach((prop) => {
                    const val = style.getPropertyValue(prop);
                    if (val && val.includes("var(")) {
                        iterate(prop, val);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        if (
            cssText.includes("background-color: ;") &&
            !style.getPropertyValue("background")
        ) {
            handleEmptyShorthand("background", style, iterate);
        }
        if (
            cssText.includes("border-") &&
            cssText.includes("-color: ;") &&
            !style.getPropertyValue("border")
        ) {
            handleEmptyShorthand("border", style, iterate);
        }
    }
    function handleEmptyShorthand(shorthand, style, iterate) {
        const parentRule = style.parentRule;
        if (isStyleRule(parentRule)) {
            const sourceCSSText =
                parentRule.parentStyleSheet?.ownerNode?.textContent;
            if (sourceCSSText) {
                let escapedSelector = escapeRegExpSpecialChars(
                    parentRule.selectorText
                );
                escapedSelector = escapedSelector.replaceAll(/\s+/g, "\\s*");
                escapedSelector = escapedSelector.replaceAll(/::/g, "::?");
                const regexp = new RegExp(
                    `${escapedSelector}\\s*{[^}]*${shorthand}:\\s*([^;}]+)`
                );
                const match = sourceCSSText.match(regexp);
                if (match) {
                    iterate(shorthand, match[1]);
                }
            } else if (shorthand === "background") {
                iterate("background-color", "#ffffff");
            }
        }
    }
    const cssURLRegex = /url\((('.*?')|(".*?")|([^\)]*?))\)/g;
    const cssImportRegex =
        /@import\s*(url\()?(('.+?')|(".+?")|([^\)]*?))\)? ?(screen)?;?/gi;
    function getCSSURLValue(cssURL) {
        return cssURL
            .trim()
            .replace(/[\n\r\\]+/g, "")
            .replace(/^url\((.*)\)$/, "$1")
            .trim()
            .replace(/^"(.*)"$/, "$1")
            .replace(/^'(.*)'$/, "$1")
            .replace(/(?:\\(.))/g, "$1");
    }
    function getCSSBaseBath(url) {
        const cssURL = parseURL(url);
        return `${cssURL.origin}${cssURL.pathname.replace(/\?.*$/, "").replace(/(\/)([^\/]+)$/i, "$1")}`;
    }
    function replaceCSSRelativeURLsWithAbsolute($css, cssBasePath) {
        return $css.replace(cssURLRegex, (match) => {
            try {
                const url = getCSSURLValue(match);
                const absoluteURL = getAbsoluteURL(cssBasePath, url);
                const escapedURL = absoluteURL.replaceAll("'", "\\'");
                return `url('${escapedURL}')`;
            } catch (err) {
                return match;
            }
        });
    }
    const fontFaceRegex = /@font-face\s*{[^}]*}/g;
    function replaceCSSFontFace($css) {
        return $css.replace(fontFaceRegex, "");
    }
    const styleRules = new WeakSet();
    const importRules = new WeakSet();
    const mediaRules = new WeakSet();
    const supportsRules = new WeakSet();
    const layerRules = new WeakSet();
    function isStyleRule(rule) {
        if (!rule) {
            return false;
        }
        if (styleRules.has(rule)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (rule.selectorText) {
            styleRules.add(rule);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function isImportRule(rule) {
        if (!rule) {
            return false;
        }
        if (styleRules.has(rule)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (importRules.has(rule)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (rule.href) {
            importRules.add(rule);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function isMediaRule(rule) {
        if (!rule) {
            return false;
        }
        if (styleRules.has(rule)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (mediaRules.has(rule)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (rule.media) {
            mediaRules.add(rule);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function isSupportsRule(rule) {
        if (!rule) {
            return false;
        }
        if (styleRules.has(rule)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (supportsRules.has(rule)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (rule instanceof CSSSupportsRule) {
            supportsRules.add(rule);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function isLayerRule(rule) {
        if (!rule) {
            return false;
        }
        if (styleRules.has(rule)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (layerRules.has(rule)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (isLayerRuleSupported && rule instanceof CSSLayerBlockRule) {
            layerRules.add(rule);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function evalMath(expression) {
        const rpnStack = [];
        const workingStack = [];
        let lastToken;
        for (let i = 0, len = expression.length; i < len; i++) {
            const token = expression[i];
            if (!token || token === " ") {
                continue;
            }
            if (operators.has(token)) {
                const op = operators.get(token);
                while (workingStack.length) {
                    const currentOp = operators.get(workingStack[0]);
                    if (!currentOp) {
                        break;
                    }
                    if (op.lessOrEqualThan(currentOp)) {
                        rpnStack.push(workingStack.shift());
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                workingStack.unshift(token);
            } else if (!lastToken || operators.has(lastToken)) {
                rpnStack.push(token);
            } else {
                rpnStack[rpnStack.length - 1] += token;
            }
            lastToken = token;
        }
        rpnStack.push(...workingStack);
        const stack = [];
        for (let i = 0, len = rpnStack.length; i < len; i++) {
            const op = operators.get(rpnStack[i]);
            if (op) {
                const args = stack.splice(0, 2);
                stack.push(op.exec(args[1], args[0]));
            } else {
                stack.unshift(parseFloat(rpnStack[i]));
            }
        }
        return stack[0];
    }
    class Operator {
        constructor(precedence, method) {
            this.precendce = precedence;
            this.execMethod = method;
        }
        exec(left, right) {
            return this.execMethod(left, right);
        }
        lessOrEqualThan(op) {
            return this.precendce <= op.precendce;
        }
    }
    const operators = new Map([
        ["+", new Operator(1, (left, right) => left + right)],
        ["-", new Operator(1, (left, right) => left - right)],
        ["*", new Operator(2, (left, right) => left * right)],
        ["/", new Operator(2, (left, right) => left / right)]
    ]);

    const isSystemDarkModeEnabled = () =>
        matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;

    const hslaParseCache = new Map();
    const rgbaParseCache = new Map();
    function parseColorWithCache($color) {
        $color = $color.trim();
        if (rgbaParseCache.has($color)) {
            return rgbaParseCache.get($color);
        }
        if ($color.includes("calc(")) {
            $color = lowerCalcExpression($color);
        }
        const color = parse($color);
        color && rgbaParseCache.set($color, color);
        return color;
    }
    function parseToHSLWithCache(color) {
        if (hslaParseCache.has(color)) {
            return hslaParseCache.get(color);
        }
        const rgb = parseColorWithCache(color);
        if (!rgb) {
            return null;
        }
        const hsl = rgbToHSL(rgb);
        hslaParseCache.set(color, hsl);
        return hsl;
    }
    function clearColorCache() {
        hslaParseCache.clear();
        rgbaParseCache.clear();
    }
    function hslToRGB({h, s, l, a = 1}) {
        if (s === 0) {
            const [r, b, g] = [l, l, l].map((x) => Math.round(x * 255));
            return {r, g, b, a};
        }
        const c = (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) * s;
        const x = c * (1 - Math.abs(((h / 60) % 2) - 1));
        const m = l - c / 2;
        const [r, g, b] = (
            h < 60
                ? [c, x, 0]
                : h < 120
                  ? [x, c, 0]
                  : h < 180
                    ? [0, c, x]
                    : h < 240
                      ? [0, x, c]
                      : h < 300
                        ? [x, 0, c]
                        : [c, 0, x]
        ).map((n) => Math.round((n + m) * 255));
        return {r, g, b, a};
    }
    function rgbToHSL({r: r255, g: g255, b: b255, a = 1}) {
        const r = r255 / 255;
        const g = g255 / 255;
        const b = b255 / 255;
        const max = Math.max(r, g, b);
        const min = Math.min(r, g, b);
        const c = max - min;
        const l = (max + min) / 2;
        if (c === 0) {
            return {h: 0, s: 0, l, a};
        }
        let h =
            (max === r
                ? ((g - b) / c) % 6
                : max === g
                  ? (b - r) / c + 2
                  : (r - g) / c + 4) * 60;
        if (h < 0) {
            h += 360;
        }
        const s = c / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1));
        return {h, s, l, a};
    }
    function toFixed(n, digits = 0) {
        const fixed = n.toFixed(digits);
        if (digits === 0) {
            return fixed;
        }
        const dot = fixed.indexOf(".");
        if (dot >= 0) {
            const zerosMatch = fixed.match(/0+$/);
            if (zerosMatch) {
                if (zerosMatch.index === dot + 1) {
                    return fixed.substring(0, dot);
                }
                return fixed.substring(0, zerosMatch.index);
            }
        }
        return fixed;
    }
    function rgbToString(rgb) {
        const {r, g, b, a} = rgb;
        if (a != null && a < 1) {
            return `rgba(${toFixed(r)}, ${toFixed(g)}, ${toFixed(b)}, ${toFixed(a, 2)})`;
        }
        return `rgb(${toFixed(r)}, ${toFixed(g)}, ${toFixed(b)})`;
    }
    function rgbToHexString({r, g, b, a}) {
        return `#${(a != null && a < 1
            ? [r, g, b, Math.round(a * 255)]
            : [r, g, b]
        )
            .map((x) => {
                return `${x < 16 ? "0" : ""}${x.toString(16)}`;
            })
            .join("")}`;
    }
    function hslToString(hsl) {
        const {h, s, l, a} = hsl;
        if (a != null && a < 1) {
            return `hsla(${toFixed(h)}, ${toFixed(s * 100)}%, ${toFixed(l * 100)}%, ${toFixed(a, 2)})`;
        }
        return `hsl(${toFixed(h)}, ${toFixed(s * 100)}%, ${toFixed(l * 100)}%)`;
    }
    const rgbMatch = /^rgba?\([^\(\)]+\)$/;
    const hslMatch = /^hsla?\([^\(\)]+\)$/;
    const hexMatch = /^#[0-9a-f]+$/i;
    function parse($color) {
        const c = $color.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (c.match(rgbMatch)) {
            return parseRGB(c);
        }
        if (c.match(hslMatch)) {
            return parseHSL(c);
        }
        if (c.match(hexMatch)) {
            return parseHex(c);
        }
        if (knownColors.has(c)) {
            return getColorByName(c);
        }
        if (systemColors.has(c)) {
            return getSystemColor(c);
        }
        if ($color === "transparent") {
            return {r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 0};
        }
        if (
            (c.startsWith("color(") || c.startsWith("color-mix(")) &&
            c.endsWith(")")
        ) {
            return domParseColor(c);
        }
        if (c.startsWith("light-dark(") && c.endsWith(")")) {
            const match = c.match(
                /^light-dark\(\s*([a-z]+(\(.*\))?),\s*([a-z]+(\(.*\))?)\s*\)$/
            );
            if (match) {
                const schemeColor = isSystemDarkModeEnabled()
                    ? match[3]
                    : match[1];
                return parse(schemeColor);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function getNumbers($color) {
        const numbers = [];
        let prevPos = 0;
        let isMining = false;
        const startIndex = $color.indexOf("(");
        $color = $color.substring(startIndex + 1, $color.length - 1);
        for (let i = 0; i < $color.length; i++) {
            const c = $color[i];
            if ((c >= "0" && c <= "9") || c === "." || c === "+" || c === "-") {
                isMining = true;
            } else if (isMining && (c === " " || c === "," || c === "/")) {
                numbers.push($color.substring(prevPos, i));
                isMining = false;
                prevPos = i + 1;
            } else if (!isMining) {
                prevPos = i + 1;
            }
        }
        if (isMining) {
            numbers.push($color.substring(prevPos, $color.length));
        }
        return numbers;
    }
    function getNumbersFromString(str, range, units) {
        const raw = getNumbers(str);
        const unitsList = Object.entries(units);
        const numbers = raw
            .map((r) => r.trim())
            .map((r, i) => {
                let n;
                const unit = unitsList.find(([u]) => r.endsWith(u));
                if (unit) {
                    n =
                        (parseFloat(r.substring(0, r.length - unit[0].length)) /
                            unit[1]) *
                        range[i];
                } else {
                    n = parseFloat(r);
                }
                if (range[i] > 1) {
                    return Math.round(n);
                }
                return n;
            });
        return numbers;
    }
    const rgbRange = [255, 255, 255, 1];
    const rgbUnits = {"%": 100};
    function parseRGB($rgb) {
        const [r, g, b, a = 1] = getNumbersFromString($rgb, rgbRange, rgbUnits);
        return {r, g, b, a};
    }
    const hslRange = [360, 1, 1, 1];
    const hslUnits = {"%": 100, "deg": 360, "rad": 2 * Math.PI, "turn": 1};
    function parseHSL($hsl) {
        const [h, s, l, a = 1] = getNumbersFromString($hsl, hslRange, hslUnits);
        return hslToRGB({h, s, l, a});
    }
    function parseHex($hex) {
        const h = $hex.substring(1);
        switch (h.length) {
            case 3:
            case 4: {
                const [r, g, b] = [0, 1, 2].map((i) =>
                    parseInt(`${h[i]}${h[i]}`, 16)
                );
                const a =
                    h.length === 3 ? 1 : parseInt(`${h[3]}${h[3]}`, 16) / 255;
                return {r, g, b, a};
            }
            case 6:
            case 8: {
                const [r, g, b] = [0, 2, 4].map((i) =>
                    parseInt(h.substring(i, i + 2), 16)
                );
                const a =
                    h.length === 6 ? 1 : parseInt(h.substring(6, 8), 16) / 255;
                return {r, g, b, a};
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function getColorByName($color) {
        const n = knownColors.get($color);
        return {
            r: (n >> 16) & 255,
            g: (n >> 8) & 255,
            b: (n >> 0) & 255,
            a: 1
        };
    }
    function getSystemColor($color) {
        const n = systemColors.get($color);
        return {
            r: (n >> 16) & 255,
            g: (n >> 8) & 255,
            b: (n >> 0) & 255,
            a: 1
        };
    }
    function lowerCalcExpression(color) {
        let searchIndex = 0;
        const replaceBetweenIndices = (start, end, replacement) => {
            color =
                color.substring(0, start) + replacement + color.substring(end);
        };
        while ((searchIndex = color.indexOf("calc(")) !== -1) {
            const range = getParenthesesRange(color, searchIndex);
            if (!range) {
                break;
            }
            let slice = color.slice(range.start + 1, range.end - 1);
            const includesPercentage = slice.includes("%");
            slice = slice.split("%").join("");
            const output = Math.round(evalMath(slice));
            replaceBetweenIndices(
                range.start - 4,
                range.end,
                output + (includesPercentage ? "%" : "")
            );
        }
        return color;
    }

    function scale(x, inLow, inHigh, outLow, outHigh) {
        return ((x - inLow) * (outHigh - outLow)) / (inHigh - inLow) + outLow;
    }
    function clamp(x, min, max) {
